description:
**Remote Lead Generation Specialist — $300/Month + $50 Per Closed Client**



Houston Auto Bonds is a Texas-based vehicle title-services company looking for a motivated remote Lead Generation Specialist to bring us real, qualified customers.



We help people with title transfers, bonded titles, registration-related services, and other vehicle-document needs. Your job is to help connect us with customers who genuinely need these services and are ready to speak with our team.



This is a long-term remote opportunity for someone experienced in lead generation, digital marketing,
/Instagram advertising, Google Ads, local SEO, social-media outreach, referral marketing, or customer acquisition.



**Worldwide remote applicants are welcome.** Strong written English, clear communication, honesty, and reliable reporting are required.



**What You Will Do**



* Generate qualified customer inquiries for Houston Auto Bonds.

* Send leads directly to our approved business
, phone number, text line, CRM, or online form.

* Use ethical methods such as
/Instagram ads, Google Ads, local SEO, social-media marketing, referral partnerships, content marketing, or direct outreach.

* Focus on customers in Texas, especially the Houston area, who need title transfers, bonded titles, or related vehicle-title services.

* Track where each lead came from and provide basic reporting on your work.

* Test and improve your strategies based on which sources produce real paying customers.

* Communicate professionally and protect customer information.



**What Counts as a Qualified Lead**



A qualified lead must be a real person who:



* Has a genuine need for one of our services;

* Provides valid contact information;

* Is located in an area we can serve or is otherwise eligible for our services;

* Has agreed to be contacted by Houston Auto Bonds; and

* Is not a duplicate, fake, spam, scraped contact, or unrelated inquiry.



We care about quality, not just numbers. Misleading advertising, fake leads, duplicate leads, or leads without consent will not count.



**Compensation**



* **Base pay:** $300 per month

* **Commission:** $50 for each client you generate who completes service with Houston Auto Bonds

* **Commission payout:** Paid daily after the customer’s completed service is verified

title: Static ad designer for Meta ads
description:
We run e-commerce brands and advertise on
 and Instagram. Static ads are a big part of what works for us. We're looking for a designer who can take over producing them.



What you'll do



You'll create static ads based on briefs and copy we provide. Usually that means taking an ad that already performs and making variations of it: different product, background, headline or format. Think 5 to 10 statics per batch, delivered within a few days.



You'll also clean up product photos when needed: cutouts, shadows, retouching, and making sure the product looks sharp and correct.



What we expect



1. You've designed static ads for e-commerce or DTC brands before, and you can show examples in your portfolio. Logos and websites don't count.

2. You're strong in photo editing, especially compositing and retouching (Photoshop or similar). The product has to look real, because it's the hero of every ad.

3. You know common ad formats, like Pubity-style posts, chat screenshots and comment threads, and you understand why simple and readable usually wins.

4. You can create ads in languages you don't speak. We advertise in each market's native language, so you need to understand what an ad says and why it works before you design it. That means using AI properly: translating the copy, understanding the DTC messaging behind it, and checking your final text word for word. Mistakes in the copy aren't acceptable.

5. You're comfortable working with AI tools. We'll give you access to a Higgsfield account and a ChatGPT or Claude account for generating images, working out concepts and handling translations.



How it works



Freelance and remote, ongoing work if we're a good fit. We start with a small paid test: we'll send you one of our winning ads plus product photos, and you make 3 variations within 48 hours.



To apply



Send 3 to 5 winning static ads you've made for e-commerce brands and explain why they're winning, and send us 3 losing ads you've made, and explain to us why they were considered losing ads.



Salary

Base pay + 5% commission on the ad spend of a winning batch (KPI must be 2+ roas and only counts from a minimum of €500 spend in past 30 days.

Tech VA – Voice AI & Podcast Production



Contract Type: Contract

Compensation: $6–$12/hour

Time Zone: EST

Work Arrangement: Remote



Role Overview



We are looking for a Tech VA with hands-on experience in Voice AI and podcast production to provide technical, content, marketing, and project support.



The ideal candidate has experience building, configuring, upgrading, or maintaining AI voice agents, particularly using VAPI or similar voice assistant platforms, along with practical experience producing and editing podcasts.

Key Responsibilities



Voice AI & Technical Support

Build, configure, test, and improve AI voice agents using VAPI or similar voice assistant platforms.

Modify and upgrade existing voice assistants based on requirements.

Configure voice agent prompts, workflows, call logic, integrations, and related settings.

Troubleshoot voice-agent issues and identify opportunities for improvement.

Demonstrate working voice AI projects during the interview process.

Learn and work with new AI tools, platforms, and technical workflows as required.



Podcast & Content Production

Assist with end-to-end podcast production.

Edit podcast audio and/or video for quality, clarity, pacing, and engagement.

Prepare podcasts for publishing across relevant platforms.

Assist with titles, descriptions, show notes, thumbnails, clips, and other supporting content.

Repurpose long-form podcast content into short-form content where required.

Support activities designed to increase podcast reach, traffic, and audience engagement.



Marketing & General Support

Assist with day-to-day marketing and operational tasks.

Support content distribution and social media-related activities.

Assist with building and fulfilling client deliverables and solutions.

Maintain organized project files, task lists, and deliverables.

Track assigned tasks, deadlines, priorities, and project status.

Communicate progress, questions, and blockers clearly and promptly.



Essential Qualifications

Hands-on experience building or managing AI voice agents.

Experience with VAPI or a similar voice AI/voice assistant platform.

Ability to demonstrate at least one voice assistant/voice AI project built or managed.

Practical experience with podcast production and editing.

Strong project/task management and organizational skills.

Clear, timely, and professional communication.

Ability to learn new technical tools and workflows quickly.

title: ROOFING APPOINTMENT SETTER
description:
FULL-TIME REMOTE | BASE PAY + UNCAPPED PERFORMANCE BONUSES | LEADS PROVIDED



***COMPENSATION: $250 USD GUARANTEED MONTHLY BASE + UNCAPPED PERFORMANCE BONUSES***

***REALISTIC TARGET AFTER RAMP-UP: $700–$1,200+ USD/MONTH***

***STRONG PERFORMERS CAN EXCEED $1,500/MONTH***



We provide the roofing-company lists. You do not find leads and you do not close sales.



We are hiring 2 talented appointment setters to join our growing U.S. roofing sales team.



If you are confident on the phone, enjoy competition, and know how to get business owners to take a meeting, we want to hear from you.



You do NOT need to find leads.



You do NOT need to close sales.



WE PROVIDE THE ROOFING COMPANY LISTS.



Your job:



CALL → REACH THE DECISION-MAKER → CREATE INTEREST → BOOK THE DEMO → GET THEM TO SHOW



Our dedicated sales closers take over from there.



WHAT ARE WE SELLING?



A done-for-you AI phone receptionist built for U.S. roofing companies.



It helps roofing companies capture incoming opportunities they may otherwise miss when the office is busy, the team is in the field, or calls come in after hours.



YOUR COMPENSATION



GUARANTEED BASE:

$250 USD/month



PLUS:



+$10 USD for every qualified demo that ATTENDS



PLUS:



+$150 USD every time one of YOUR appointments becomes a paying customer



PERFORMANCE ACCELERATOR:



Once you generate 5 closed customers in the same month, customer #5 and every additional customer that month pays you a $200 bonus instead of $150.



THERE IS NO COMMISSION CAP.



EXAMPLE:



30 qualified demos attend.



6 become paying customers.



Base Pay = $250



30 Attended Demos = $300



Customers #1–4 = $600



Customers #5–6 = $400



TOTAL EARNINGS = $1,550 USD



Generate 40 attended demos and 8+ customers and your earning potential increases further.



We WANT our best setters to make great money.



The better you perform, the more you earn.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



• Roofing company lists

• Dialing system

• CRM

• Proven sales process

• Call script

• Objection handling

• Roofing industry training

• Product training

• Demo calendar

• Dedicated sales closers

• Coaching and performance feedback



You focus on ONE job:



BOOK QUALIFIED ROOFING OWNERS AND DECISION-MAKERS AND GET THEM TO ATTEND THE DEMO.



WHO WE WANT



We are looking for people who:



• Speak excellent English

• Sound confident and natural on the phone

• Have U.S. cold-calling experience

• Are comfortable speaking with business owners

• Can handle high-volume outbound calling

• Don't get discouraged by rejection

• Can handle gatekeepers

• Are competitive

• Are coachable

• Show up consistently

• Keep accurate CRM records

• Have reliable internet

• Have a quality headset and quiet workspace



Experience calling roofing, solar, construction, restoration, HVAC, plumbing or other U.S. home-service companies is a BIG advantage.



ROOFING EXPERIENCE IS NOT REQUIRED.



WE WILL TRAIN YOU.



Our founder previously worked inside the roofing industry and will personally train our appointment setters.



You will learn how roofing companies operate, roofing terminology, roofing leads, inspections, storm/insurance opportunities, common problems roofing owners experience, and how our service helps their business.



We don't want you blindly reading a script.



We want you to understand the business owner you're calling.



HOW TO APPLY



Send us:



Your name

Where you live in the Philippines

Years of cold-calling experience

Industries you've called

Any roofing/home-services experience

Average number of outbound calls you made per day in your previous role

Your previous appointment-setting results, if known

Dialers/CRMs you've used

U.S. time zones you've worked

A 60–90 second voice recording



IMPORTANT — VOICE AUDITION



Imagine I answer the phone:



“ABC Roofing, this is Colton.”



You are cold calling me.



Your goal is to get me interested enough to schedule a short demonstration of our AI receptionist.



Record yourself actually making the pitch.



DO NOT explain what you would say.



Actually perform the cold call.



Applications without the voice recording will not be considered.



HIRING PROCESS



Application

→ Voice Audition

→ Short Interview

→ Live Cold-Call Roleplay

→ Final Selection

→ Roofing + Product Training

→ Start Calling



We are hiring TWO setters.



This is intended to be a long-term opportunity for people who want to grow with our company.



If you're competitive, confident on the phone, and want your income tied to your performance, apply.

title: Customer Success Manager - Listing Residential Real Estate
description:
TRANSACTION & LISTINGS COORDINATOR / EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT

SMPL Realty | SMPL Property Management | The Xpress Companies

St. Louis, Missouri, USA



Full-time | Remote (Philippines) | US Central business hours | Reports directly to the Broker



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are a growing real estate group in St. Louis, Missouri with three related businesses: a residential brokerage, a property management company, and an REO/BPO valuation firm. You will run the paperwork engine behind all three. You keep every file compliant, every deadline met, and the broker's day organized.



The split is about 60% transaction coordination and listing management for the brokerage and 40% property management, REO/BPO, and executive support. We review the split at 90 days.



Tools you will use: Follow Up Boss, the MLS, Rentvine, Google Workspace, e-signature and transaction compliance platforms.



Accuracy and follow-through are the whole job. A missed deadline or an incomplete file costs real money.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

- Listing to close: Take over the client at verbal acceptance of the listing and coordinate everything through closing: paperwork, deadlines, vendors, title, lender, and status updates.

- Contract to close: Open each file at contract acceptance, deliver documents to title and lender, build and run the deadline calendar (inspection, financing, appraisal, closing), chase signatures and missing documents, send weekly status updates, prepare closing paperwork and commission disbursement, and archive the completed file.

- Broker compliance checks: Audit every file against our Missouri compliance checklist. No file is marked complete and no commission is released until the checklist passes.

- Listing input: Enter new listings into the MLS within 24 hours with zero errors. Process price changes and status updates the same day.

- Listing coordination: Schedule photographers, signs, and lockboxes. Set up showing services. Collect and relay showing feedback. Track days on market.

- Property management support: Rentvine data entry, lease renewal tracking, tenant lead pipeline, and owner reports.

- REO/BPO support: Order status updates, portal document uploads, and photo quality checks.

- Executive assistant to the broker: Inbox triage, calendar, vendor scheduling, CRM cleanup, and recurring admin across all three companies.



IMPORTANT: This is an unlicensed administrative role. You will never negotiate contract terms, give advice on price or terms, solicit new business by phone, or conduct showings.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

- Zero missed contract deadlines

- 100% of closed files pass the compliance checklist before commission release

- Listings live in the MLS within 24 hours with zero data errors

- Broker and agent requests answered the same business day



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years supporting US real estate transactions (transaction coordinator, listing coordinator, or brokerage admin)

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Experience with a CRM (Follow Up Boss or similar), MLS entry, e-signature platforms, and Google Workspace. Rentvine or property management software is a plus.

- Available Monday to Friday on US Central Time

- Reliable high-speed internet with backup power and internet

- Very detail-oriented. You catch the wrong date on page 7.

- Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) in your daily work



COMPENSATION

- Base pay: $800 USD per month, paid twice a month (Wise or similar). Independent contractor.

- Closing bonus: $30 for every brokerage closing you coordinate in the month

- Pace bonus: an extra $100 in any month with 8 or more closings

- Operations bonus: $150 per quarter for hitting property management and operations targets

- 13th month pay: one month of base pay every December (pro-rated in year one)

- Pay review at 90 days, then every year



Example months:

5 closings = $950 total

8 closings = $1,140 total

12 closings = $1,260 total

Quarterly bonus and 13th month pay are on top of this.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

We only accept applications through WhatsApp. Do not call this number. WhatsApp messages only. Applications sent any other way will not be reviewed.



WhatsApp: 
Send us these 4 things on WhatsApp:



1) A TEXT MESSAGE that starts with the words "SMPL Coordinator" followed by your full name and your OnlineJobs.ph profile link.



2) A VIDEO OF YOURSELF (1 to 2 minutes). We want to see and hear you.

   - Your face must be clearly visible the whole time. Good lighting, no filters, no background music.

   - Record it yourself in one take. No AI voices, avatars, or edited clips.

   - Start by saying your full name and today's date.

   - Then read this script out loud:



"Hi, this is [your name], your transaction coordinator with SMPL Realty. I'm calling with an update on your home at 123 Main Street. The buyer's home inspection was completed yesterday, and we expect their repair request by Friday at 5 p.m. Central Time. Once we receive it, your agent will review it with you and go over your options. In the meantime, the appraisal has been ordered, and title work is in progress. Our closing date is still on track for October 30th. If you have any questions, please call or text me at this number. Thank you, and have a great day."



   - Then answer this question in your own words (do not read it): "Tell us about a time you caught a mistake that other people missed. What happened?"



3) YOUR RESUME (PDF or Word).



4) A LISTING-TO-CLOSING CHECKLIST. Use any AI tool you like (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or another). Build a step-by-step checklist that takes a home seller in Missouri from the day they verbally agree to list with us all the way through closing. Assume the broker hands you the client at the moment of verbal acceptance. Include the documents, deadlines, people involved, and what you would do at each stage.

   - Send it as a PDF or a Google Doc link (set to "anyone with the link can view").

   - Tell us which AI model you used and paste the prompt(s) you gave it.

   - Edit the AI's answer. We want to see your judgment, not just the AI's first draft.



Applications missing any of the 4 items will not be reviewed.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a short paid trial task and a live video interview.

title: Burnout B2B Sales Advisor
description:
Part-Time | 10 Hours/Week Initially | $7/Hour + Commission



The Leadership Principle is seeking an experienced B2B Sales Advisor to help grow a professional-services offer focused on organizational burnout.



This role is for a proven full-cycle B2B salesperson who personally closes business. You will manage opportunities from prospecting and qualification through sales conversations, objection handling, close, and payment.



Lead-generation or appointment-setting experience alone is not sufficient.



WHAT YOU WILL SELL



You will sell a $9,500, three-week B2B advisory engagement that helps leaders identify the organizational conditions creating burnout, understand the impact on people and performance, and build a focused 90-day action plan to address the underlying causes.



The Founder delivers the engagement after the sale.



WHO YOU WILL SELL TO



Typical buyers include Directors, Senior Directors, VPs, and other leaders responsible for teams, functions, transformation efforts, PMOs, or business units.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Develop opportunities through company-provided prospects and your own prospecting

• Conduct personalized B2B outreach

• Identify and engage appropriate business decision-makers

• Qualify need, authority, budget, timing, and fit

• Conduct consultative sales conversations

• Handle objections and maintain disciplined follow-up

• Manage your pipeline independently

• Move qualified opportunities through the full sales cycle

• Close business and secure client payment

• Hand paid clients to the Founder for delivery



COMPENSATION



Base Pay: $7/hour



Company-Sourced Business:

4% of net collected client revenue



Advisor-Sourced Business:

7% of net collected client revenue



Advisor-sourced opportunities earn the higher commission because the Advisor is responsible for originating and closing the business.



SCHEDULE



10 hours per week initially, with the opportunity to increase based on demonstrated performance and pipeline development.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• 5+ years of direct B2B sales experience with demonstrated responsibility for personally closing business

• Experience managing the full sales cycle independently, from prospecting and qualification through close

• Evidence of measurable closed revenue or sales results

• Experience selling higher-value B2B services, professional services, or solutions

• Experience selling to Directors, VPs, executives, or other senior business decision-makers

• Strong discovery, qualification, objection-handling, and closing skills

• Strong written and spoken English

• Ability to manage prospecting, follow-up, and pipeline activity with minimal day-to-day supervision



Experience selling consulting, advisory services, HR solutions, leadership services, organizational development, transformation services, or similar B2B offerings is especially relevant.



APPLICATION QUESTIONS



Please answer all three questions:



1. How many years of direct B2B sales experience do you have, what products or services have you personally sold, and what was the typical price?



2. Describe one B2B sale you personally managed from prospecting or initial contact through close. Who was the buyer, and did you source the opportunity yourself or receive the lead from the company?



3. What measurable closed-sales or revenue results can you share from your most recent or relevant sales role?

title: COLD CALLER / APPOINTMENT SETTER — COMMERCIAL CLEANING COMPANY (CANADA)
description:
COLD CALLER / APPOINTMENT SETTER — COMMERCIAL CLEANING COMPANY (CANADA)



Read this whole post before applying. Instructions are at the bottom and I

will know if you skipped them.



ABOUT US

We are a commercial cleaning company on Vancouver Island, British Columbia,

Canada. We clean offices, dental clinics, restaurants and commercial

buildings. We are growing and I need one sharp person on the phones so I can

focus on quoting and running the work.



THE ROLE

Your job is simple to explain and hard to do well: turn cold calls into warm

leads.



- Build and organize your own lead lists. I will train you on exactly how I

  find prospects, then you run it yourself. I cannot spend my time building

  lists for you.

- Call businesses and get past the gatekeeper to the decision maker

- Book me free on-site estimates

- Follow up by phone and
 until you get a yes or a no

- Keep our lead tracker updated every single day

- Report to me daily on what you did and what happened



You are not just dialing. You own the top of our sales pipeline.



PAY

- $500 CAD per month base, paid every two weeks

- PLUS $300 CAD commission for every client that signs

- No cap on commission. Book more, earn more.



To be clear about what that means: land four clients in a month and you have

made $1,700 CAD that month. I would rather pay you a lot than pay you a

little, but you have to produce.



HOURS

40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 8 hours per day.

8:00 AM - 4:00 PM Pacific Time.



In Philippine time that is roughly 11:00 PM to 7:00 AM, shifting by an hour

when daylight saving changes.



Your day is structured:

   8:00 AM -  9:00 AM PT   Prep - build and organize leads, plan your calls,

                           send
 follow-ups

   9:00 AM - 12:00 PM PT   Calling block

  12:00 PM -  1:00 PM PT   Lunch, plus any
 follow-ups that need to go

                           out. Canadian decision makers are at lunch then

                           so dialing is wasted time.

   1:00 PM -  4:00 PM PT   Calling block



Yes, it is an overnight shift. But you are finished by 7:00 AM Philippine

time with your whole day ahead of you. If you cannot commit to that schedule,

please do not apply. I would rather you tell me now than quit in week two.



WHAT I NEED FROM YOU

- Fluent, confident, clear spoken English. You will be talking to business

  owners and office managers. They need to understand you instantly.

- Previous cold calling or appointment setting experience

- Ability to research and build your own lead lists once trained

- Thick skin. You will get hung up on. That is the job.

- Reliable internet, a good headset, and a quiet place to work

- Someone who follows up without being reminded

- Someone who tells me the truth about their numbers, good or bad



WHAT I GIVE YOU

- Full training on our services, our scripts, and exactly how to find leads

- Objection handling and everything you need to sound like you know our

  business, because you will

- Direct access to me. You work with the owner, not a manager.

- Room to grow. If you are good, this role grows and so does your pay.



HONEST EXPECTATIONS

I will be monitoring your work closely, especially in the first week. I am

hiring one person right now and I will keep that person busy and earning.



I want someone who treats this like their own business. If you are looking

for a quiet job where nobody checks on you, this is not it. If you want to

work hard, be held to a real standard and get paid properly for results,

apply.



HOW TO APPLY

Do all four or your application will be skipped:



1. Start your message with the word COCONUT so I know you read this post.

2. Send a voice recording (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, in English.

title: Meta Ads Specialist - Ecommerce/Swimwear/Bridal
description:
Remote | Contract / Part-Time with opportunity to grow



We are looking for an experienced **Meta Ads Specialist** to manage and scale paid advertising across our own ecommerce brands and selected ecommerce clients.



Required

- 5+ years experience working with Meta Ads

- 5+ years experience working with lingerie/swimwear for women and men successfully. 



*NOTE: This is not an entry-level media buying role. Do not apply if you are new to Meta Ads +Ecommerce.

* Proof of work will be required, and a reference check will be done. 



A major part of this position will involve managing a swimwear brand specialising in micro bikinis and bold swimwear. It is a challenging Meta account that requires someone who understands both **ecommerce performance marketing and Meta's advertising policies around swimwear, lingerie, body exposure and suggestive creative**.



For this reason, **previous hands-on experience running Meta Ads for a bikini, swimwear, lingerie or closely related fashion brand is required.**



## What You Will Be Responsible For



You will take ownership of Meta advertising across multiple accounts, including:



* Developing Meta Ads strategies based on revenue, ROAS, CPA and profitability targets

* Managing
 and Instagram campaigns through Meta Ads Manager

* Structuring and optimising campaigns across prospecting, retargeting and existing customer audiences

* Managing Advantage+ Shopping, manual campaigns and testing structures where appropriate

* Developing systematic creative testing strategies

* Identifying winning creatives, hooks, offers, audiences and landing pages

* Scaling profitable campaigns while controlling CPA and maintaining efficiency

* Analysing performance across campaign, ad set and individual creative level

* Monitoring attribution and comparing Meta performance against Shopify, GA4 and other available data

* Working with our creative and ecommerce teams to develop new advertising concepts

* Providing clear briefs for static ads, video ads, UGC and other creative assets

* Identifying account issues before they become expensive problems

* Keeping up with changes to Meta's advertising platform, algorithms and policies

* Ensuring ad accounts do not get flagged for violations or get banned

* Producing concise performance reports with clear recommendations and next actions



## Swimwear Brand – A Key Part of This Role, requires a more experienced media buyer than a conventional ecommerce account.



The brand operates within a category where Meta can interpret certain bikini imagery as overly sexualised or restricted, even when the products themselves are legitimate swimwear.



You will need to understand how to:



* Advertise swimwear and revealing fashion while remaining within Meta advertising policies

* Identify which creatives are likely to trigger disapprovals or account restrictions

* Develop advertising concepts that maintain the identity of a bold brand without unnecessarily increasing policy risk

* Separate organic brand creative from paid-media-safe creative where required

* Work around limited creative options without producing bland advertising

* Troubleshoot rejected ads and account restrictions

* Scale a fashion brand where visual creative is one of the primary drivers of performance

* Develop creative angles that appeal to different customer segments while protecting the account



We are **not** looking for someone to simply upload whatever creative is supplied and wait to see whether Meta approves it. We need someone who understands the platform well enough to anticipate problems and develop solutions.



## You Must Have



* Proven experience managing Meta Ads for ecommerce businesses

* **Previous experience advertising a bikini, swimwear, lingerie or closely related brand**

* Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager

* Strong understanding of Meta advertising policies relating to fashion, swimwear, lingerie and suggestive content

* Experience managing ecommerce conversion campaigns

* Experience with Shopify-based businesses

* Strong understanding of ROAS, MER, CPA, CPM, CTR, CVR, AOV and customer acquisition economics

* Experience testing and scaling creatives systematically

* Ability to interpret performance data rather than relying solely on Meta's recommendations

* Experience managing multiple advertising accounts

* Strong written communication and reporting skills

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of performance



## Highly Regarded



Experience with any of the following would be valuable:



* Women's fashion or apparel

* Intimate apparel

* Bridal Brand 

* Gifting 

* Beauty or lifestyle ecommerce

* UGC advertising

* Creative strategy

* Klaviyo

* GA4

* Shopify analytics

* Landing-page optimisation

* Conversion-rate optimisation

* International ecommerce campaigns

* Australian and US ecommerce markets



## What We Are Not Looking For



This role will not suit someone whose experience consists primarily of:



* Boosting social media posts

* Lead generation for local service businesses

* Organic social media management

* Following automated Meta recommendations without independent analysis

* Running one campaign structure across every account

* Reporting vanity metrics without understanding commercial performance



We need a **performance-focused ecommerce media buyer** who understands that creative, merchandising, offers, website conversion and paid media all influence results.



## What Success Looks Like



You will be expected to understand each business commercially, not simply operate Ads Manager.



That means being able to look at an account and explain:



**What is working?

What is not working?

Why?

What should we test next?

What should we stop spending money on?

Where is the opportunity to scale?**



You should be comfortable challenging assumptions and recommending changes when the data supports them.



## About The Businesses



We are a brisbane based marketing & Development agency with a number of Australian Ecommerce Clients. You will work across a mix of internally owned brands and ecommerce clients covering areas such as fashion, bridal, gifting, retail and specialist ecommerce.



You will work closely with a team covering ecommerce strategy, Shopify development, Google Ads, SEO,
 marketing, design and conversion optimisation.



This gives you access to the wider ecommerce operation rather than being expected to solve every performance problem through advertising alone.



## How To Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction outlining your Meta Ads experience.

2. The **swimwear, bikini, lingerie or intimate-apparel brands you have previously managed**.

3. Approximate monthly Meta ad spend you have personally managed.

4. Examples of ecommerce accounts you have successfully grown.

5. The markets you have advertised in.

6. Your experience dealing with Meta ad disapprovals, restricted creative or account restrictions.

7. Your approach to creative testing.

8. The metrics you use to determine whether an ecommerce account is performing well.

9. Your availability and preferred working arrangement.



Please include screenshots, case studies or performance data demonstrating results.



**Applications without relevant ecommerce Meta Ads experience will not be considered. 



Previous experience within swimwear, bikinis, lingerie or a closely related category is essential.**

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - Workforce & Payroll Platform (POOLING - Agentic AI, Python, React)
description:
LOCATION: REMOTE

Working hours: Overlap required with US business hours (1 PM to 10 PM or 4PM to 1 AM Manila time, including breaks)



THE ROLE

The product tracks punches, pairs them into shifts, applies pay rules, and produces approved timecards. The next phase adds the money layer — pay rates, labor cost, payroll export — and the integrations that make the product sellable. You will own significant parts of that build end to end, across a Python backend and a React frontend, and you will do it with agentic AI tooling as a core part of how you work, not as a novelty.



This is a takeover, not a greenfield build. You will inherit code you did not write, branches that were never merged, and decisions that were never documented. Comfort with that is part of the job.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

1. Build and harden the pay rate and labor-cost layer — the critical path to a sellable product. Rates, effective dating, overtime interaction, cost rollups.

2. Extend the punch pipeline (raw → paired → contextualized) and the calculation engine that turns shifts into payable hours.

3. Ship payroll export and the period-close/finalization flow that is currently locked.

4. Work across the GraphQL API (Django + Graphene) and the React client (Vite + Apollo) — you own features vertically, not by layer.

5. Land the integration surface: payroll providers, POS, and the billing/metering path that currently exists but is not wired to anything.

6. Drive merge discipline and release hygiene on a repository that has a significant backlog of unmerged work.

7. Use agentic AI tooling to move faster than a conventional senior engineer — and be able to explain and defend where you did and did not trust it.



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



- HARD REQUIREMENTS - 



1. AGENTIC AI ENGINEERING - Non-negotiable. You already build with agentic systems, not just chat. Concretely, we expect you to be able to speak to:

a. Running coding agents against a real codebase and getting production-quality output — planning, partitioning work, reviewing agent output critically.

b. Building agentic features into a product: tool/function calling, structured output, multi-step orchestration, retries and failure handling.

c. Context engineering — what goes in, what gets summarized, what gets retrieved.

d. Evaluation: how you know an agentic feature actually works, and what you do when it silently degrades.

e. Where agents are the wrong tool. Judgement here matters more than enthusiasm.

* We will ask you to walk us through something you shipped. “I use Copilot” is not an answer to this requirement.

2. PYTHON — strong. Django (5.x), ORM and migrations at a level where you are comfortable changing a schema that has live data behind it. Celery or comparable async task processing. GraphQL via Graphene is a plus; if you know GraphQL from another stack, that transfers.

3. REACT — strong. React 18+, TypeScript, Vite, Apollo Client or equivalent. You can own a feature’s UI without a designer holding your hand, and you know the difference between a screen that demos well and a screen that survives real use.

4. NODE.JS — working proficiency. Monorepo tooling (NX/pnpm), build pipelines, and the Node-side services in the stack. You do not need to be a Node specialist, but you must be able to work in it without friction.



- STRONGLY PREFERRED - 



1. Payroll systems - Pay rules, overtime law, effective-dated rates, pay periods, accruals, retroactive correction. This domain punishes people who learn it on the job — prior exposure is worth a great deal to us.

2. Payment systems - Stripe or comparable, subscription/seat-based billing, webhooks, idempotency, reconciliation. The platform meters seats; nothing currently bills against it.

3. Multi-tenant SaaS - tenant isolation, per-tenant configuration, and the ways both go wrong.

4. AWS (ECS, RDS, S3), Terraform or CDK, CI/CD you are willing to own.

5. Working in a codebase with incomplete documentation and reconstructing intent from the code itself.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR BEYOND THE STACK



1. You finish things. The single largest problem in the codebase you are inheriting is work that was built well and never landed. We care more about what you shipped than what you started.

2. You read before you write. This system has real logic in it that is not obvious. Rewriting it because it was easier than understanding it is the most expensive mistake available here.

3. You are honest about state. “Done” means merged, tested, and deployed. If something is 70% there, we want to hear 70%.

4. You handle money code with care. Hours become wages. Errors here are not bugs, they are payroll disputes.

5. You leave a trail. Decisions written down, migrations explained, runbooks that someone else can follow.



ABOUT OUTSIDEHIRE (
)



OutsideHire is a growing outsourcing company with over 75 employees, building custom products and solutions for our clients. We're dynamic, fast-paced, and always evolving!



WHY OUTSIDEHIRE?



- An inclusive and dynamic work environment that values creativity and collaboration

- Opportunities to work on cutting-edge projects that make an impact

- Perks: Competitive salary, remote work, professional development support, etc.

While we are not interviewing for an immediate opening, successful applicants may be invited to participate in project-specific interviews when needs arise. Applications remain valid for 12 months *

title: Long & Short-Form Video Editor
description:
About the Role



We are a fast-growing wellness brand rethinking the traditional protein bar — an all-natural, whole-food protein bar using clean, recognizable ingredients. As the brand expands across retail, our founders are documenting the behind-the-scenes journey of building the business — from travelling across the US and supporting retail launches to demos, events, and everyday startup life.



We're looking for a Long & Short-Form Video Editor to turn that raw footage into engaging, story-driven content. This role will primarily focus on editing long-form YouTube-style content, supported by short-form edits for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and the founders' personal social channels.



You'll receive raw footage from the founders and be responsible for turning it into polished, engaging content that captures the personality, energy, and reality of building a fast-growing consumer brand. We're looking for someone who is more than a technical editor — you should understand storytelling, pacing, humour, hooks, and retention, and be able to identify the moments within hours of footage that are actually worth watching.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week)

Time Zone: EST business hours

Compensation: 8 USD per hour

Key Responsibilities



1. Long-Form Video Editing



Edit raw founder footage into engaging YouTube-style episodes, typically around 15–25 minutes

Review several hours of raw footage and identify the strongest moments, storylines, and narrative arcs

Turn loosely structured footage into cohesive, entertaining stories

Cut unnecessary material while maintaining natural pacing and personality

Add music, sound effects, text, graphics, subtitles, and other elements where appropriate

Handle basic colour correction, audio cleanup, and overall visual consistency

Create strong openings and hooks that encourage viewers to continue watching

Incorporate B-roll and supporting footage to strengthen storytelling

Manage revisions and deliver polished final edits on schedule

2. Short-Form Content



Turn long-form footage and standalone clips into TikToks, Instagram Reels, and other vertical content

Identify short moments that can work independently as compelling social content

Edit clips with strong hooks, captions, pacing, and platform-native formatting

Create content for both the brand and the founders' personal accounts

Develop teasers and cutdowns that help drive audiences toward longer YouTube content

Repurpose existing footage efficiently to maximise the value of each shoot

3. Content & Editing Workflow



Organise raw footage, project files, and completed assets in a clear and repeatable system

Maintain consistent editing styles, fonts, graphics, and visual treatments

Work closely with the founders to understand their preferred style and continuously refine it

Manage multiple videos at different stages of the editing process

Proactively suggest opportunities to turn existing footage into additional content

Stay current with editing styles and content trends across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram

Required Skills & Experience



Experience: 3+ years of professional video editing experience

Portfolio: Strong portfolio demonstrating both long-form and short-form editing; experience editing YouTube, documentary-style, vlog, founder-led, or behind-the-scenes content

Storytelling: Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, and audience retention; ability to take several hours of raw footage and independently determine what should make the final cut

Short-Form: Excellent short-form editing instincts for TikTok and Instagram Reels

Technical: Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software; comfortable with captions, motion graphics, sound design, and basic colour correction

Organisation: Highly organised and able to manage large volumes of footage

Communication: Excellent written and spoken English; able to work independently with limited direction

Bonus: Experience editing content for CPG, food, wellness, fitness, or lifestyle brands; experience editing founder-led YouTube series or startup/build-in-public content; basic motion graphics or After Effects experience; YouTube thumbnail design; familiarity with YouTube retention analytics; experience repurposing long-form content into multiple short-form assets



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume, portfolio and introduction video

title: Graphic Designer, Marketing & Operations Coordinator (Part-Time, Remote – Work from Home)
description:
Graphic Designer, Marketing & Operations Coordinator (Part-Time, Remote – Work from Home)



The Opportunity

Are you a mid-level graphic designer who also loves bringing order to a fast-moving creative agency? Do you enjoy taking an established brand and template system and executing it well, project after project? We're looking for a highly capable Graphic Designer, Marketing & Operations Coordinator to support an independent Australian creative agency working across creative direction, graphic design and digital services for brands and marketers.



This is not a typical task-taker VA role. This is an opportunity to become the creative production and operational backbone of a growing creative agency, starting part-time (20 hours per week), with the opportunity to grow into a full-time position as the agency continues to grow.



About the Role

This role blends hands-on graphic design production with the marketing execution and operations that keep the agency running smoothly. Roughly half your week (approximately 10–12 hours) will be spent on design production – amending and producing branded assets, flowing content into established layouts and templates, and creating social and marketing graphics in Adobe Creative Suite. The remaining hours flex week to week between agency administration and marketing execution, depending on what's needed. You'll work closely with the Creative Director, who leads creative direction and remains the face of the business and primary client contact, giving her reliable design production and operational support so she can focus on strategy, client relationships and growing the agency.



Key Responsibilities

Graphic Design & Production (approximately 10–12 hours per week)

● Confident, intermediate-level skills across Adobe Creative Suite, particularly InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop.

● Complete lower-level edits and amends to existing designs.

● Flow content into established layouts and templates accurately and on-brand.

● Support simple production and rollout work across projects.

● Create LinkedIn/social graphics and other branded marketing assets.

● Working knowledge of Canva is a bonus, not a requirement.



Marketing Execution

● Support the agency's marketing strategy through scheduling and posting content.

● Basic WordPress CMS experience for straightforward content, image and page updates (or willingness to learn from basic instructions).

● Keep the CRM (Go High Level) up to date and follow up as required.

● Support warm LinkedIn outreach and relationship-building – a smaller part of the role to begin with, with the opportunity to grow as a defined outreach system is put in place.

● Maintain an organised and forward-planned content calendar.



Agency & Project Administration

● Manage projects in ActiveCollab/WIP from quote through to delivery and ready-to-invoice, keeping timelines, deadlines and status accurate.

● Comfortable using Google Workspace / Google Drive for desktop, as they’ll need to work directly from shared project folders.

● Coordinate the internal agency team so deadlines are hit and nothing falls through the cracks.

● Liaise with the bookkeeper on invoicing and related admin.

● Support quotes and proposals through to sign-off.

● Draft and help automate repeatable client
 templates – the Creative Director remains the primary client contact.



Systems & Process

● Build and document SOPs for the processes you own – these don't exist yet, so you'll be creating them as you go.

● Bring a strong systems and automation mindset to how work gets done.

● File management is important to maintain clean project folders, file naming/version control and asset filing.

● Identify inefficiencies and suggest practical improvements.



About You

You're a capable, mid-level graphic designer who also loves bringing order to a busy creative environment. You're confident producing and amending branded assets in Adobe Creative Suite, and just as comfortable keeping a project on track in ActiveCollab or following up in a CRM. You think in systems – if a process doesn't exist yet, you're the kind of person who builds it rather than waiting to be told exactly what to do.



You're organised, reliable and comfortable taking ownership of your role without needing to be chased. You are comfortable working in an environment where priorities can shift and your week's mix of design, admin and marketing tasks will vary. Experience in a creative agency or corporate team environment is highly valued, and you understand how creative agencies operate.



You MUST have your own safe, private and distraction-free home office with a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet and stable power.



Experience & Skills

● Intermediate-level graphic design experience with confident skills in Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop.

● A portfolio demonstrating production-level design work – flowing content into templates, amends, and social/marketing assets.

● Experience in an operations, project coordination or agency admin role, ideally within a creative, marketing or agency environment.

● Experience using a CRM platform is required; experience with Go High Level (GHL) is highly preferred.

● Comfortable working with project management tools such as ActiveCollab or similar platforms.

● Strong written English with the ability to draft professional, personalised outreach and follow-up communication.

● Working knowledge of Canva is a bonus.



Personal Attributes

● Proactive and takes initiative

● Highly organised with strong attention to detail

● Reliable and accountable – follows through without being chased

● Friendly and comfortable building genuine relationships

● Systems-minded – naturally documents and improves how things work

● Comfortable moving between design, marketing and admin tasks week to week as the role grows over time



What's on Offer

● Part-time role: Starting at 20 hours per week, including approximately 10–12 hours of graphic design production.

● Remote position – work from home.

● Opportunity to potentially grow into a full-time role as the agency grows.

● Work directly with the Creative Director and play a genuine role in shaping how the agency operates.

● The chance to build systems and processes from the ground up, rather than just follow existing ones.



How to Apply (PLEASE READ CAREFULLY AND FOLLOW INSTRUCTIONS). 

Please submit:

● Your Resume and a short video with your own 1-2 minute elevator pitch based on the role.

● A portfolio or work samples showing your graphic design experience, particularly production/execution work such as template-based design, amends and social assets.

● A short summary outlining your experience with graphic design, operations/project coordination, CRM systems and agency environments.

● Briefly explain how you stay on top of competing priorities and what sets you apart from other candidates. Please ensure your summary is written by you and tailored to this role. Do NOT provide an AI generated response (I can tell).



Important note:

Please ONLY apply if you are looking for a long-term position and are comfortable with a role that blends graphic design production, agency administration and marketing execution. A lack of punctuality, integrity, professionalism or follow-through will not be tolerated. Please only apply if you feel this role genuinely aligns with your CV and experience – if this role feels like too much of a “stretch” for you and doesn't align with your skillset or experience, please do not apply. Lastly, only apply if you are open to the role eventually growing to full-time hours as the agency's needs require.

What We're Looking For



You should be:



* A pharmacist with hospital, surgery center, or clinical pharmacy experience

* Familiar with medication storage, handling, documentation, and pharmacy practices

* Organized and highly detail-oriented

* Comfortable researching healthcare regulations and guidelines online

* Able to work independently and follow through on assignments

* Interested in compliance, quality assurance, and the operational side of pharmacy

* Looking for a stable, long-term position with a small team



How to Apply

title: Content Production Studio for Clothing Brand – Long-Term Partnership
description:
We are an established e-commerce clothing brand looking for content studios, production teams, and small video production companies for an ongoing, long-term partnership.



We need a large and continuous volume of original content for advertising and social media.



We are NOT looking for video editing services.



What we primarily need from you is production: planning shoots, filming high-quality footage, working with models when necessary, and delivering the raw footage to our team.



What We Need



We want to continuously produce different types of content for our clothing brand, including:



* Model/lifestyle shoots

* Fashion B-roll

* Product close-ups

* Clothing detail shots

* Streetwear content

* Indoor and outdoor lifestyle content

* Studio content

* Product-focused content

* Unboxing content

* UGC-style content

* Social media creatives

* Advertising creatives

* Creative product showcases

* Different environments, models, locations, and concepts



Most content will primarily be visual/B-roll.



Talking content is also valuable if your team has suitable creators/models with good spoken English, but it is not a requirement.



Our business requires new content continuously.



We are looking for production partners who can potentially work with us every week or multiple times per month over the long term.



Our priority is being able to consistently produce a high volume of quality footage that our internal creative team can turn into many different advertisements and social media videos.



How We Would Work Together



We will ship our clothing directly to you.



Initially, our team will provide creative references, examples, shot ideas, and general direction.



Your team would then handle the production and send us the raw footage.



Our internal editors will handle post-production.



For example:



We provide references/creative direction → Your team plans the shoot → You arrange the necessary model/location/props → You film → You send us the organized raw footage → Our team handles editing



As our partnership develops, we want our production partners to become increasingly familiar with our brand.



Over time, we would like you to proactively suggest:



* New shoot concepts

* Locations

* Models

* Props

* Interesting environments

* Different ways to showcase our products

* Content ideas based on our previous successful creatives

* New creative directions worth testing



The goal is to eventually have a production partner who understands our brand well enough that we don't need to provide detailed references for every shoot.



Production Capabilities



Ideally, your studio/team can handle some or all of the following:



* Professional video production

* Lighting

* Studio shoots

* Lifestyle/location shoots

* Indoor and outdoor filming

* Male and female models

* Model/talent sourcing

* Location sourcing

* Props

* Creative direction

* High-volume content production

* Organized raw footage delivery



You do NOT necessarily need to provide every service listed above.



If your team is excellent at a specific type of production, we would still like to hear from you.



Models



Access to models is important.



Our products can be filmed with both male and female creators/models depending on the concept.



Not every piece of content requires someone modeling the clothing. For example, creators can also produce unboxings, product-focused shots, detail shots, aesthetic footage, and other concepts.



Please tell us what type of models/talent you currently have access to and whether you can source additional talent based on a creative brief.



Volume & Long-Term Opportunity



We need a significant amount of content and are interested in studios that have the capacity to produce consistently.



There is potential for substantial recurring work if your content performs well and the partnership works smoothly.



When applying, please tell us your production capacity rather than assuming we only need one shoot.



Compensation



We are open to discussing different pricing structures depending on your capabilities and production setup.



This could include:



* Per shoot

* Per content batch

* Day rates

* Monthly production packages

* Retainer arrangements

* Other long-term arrangements



We value long-term relationships and would prefer to establish an efficient recurring production process rather than renegotiating everything for every individual video.



How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your studio/company name and location.



2. A link to your portfolio with examples of content that your team has personally filmed/produced.



3. A brief description of your team and production capabilities.



4. What cameras, lighting, audio, and other relevant equipment do you use?



5. Do you have your own studio? If yes, please provide photos or examples of the space.



6. Can you source models based on our requirements?



7. How many shoots could your team realistically handle per week or month?



8. What is your typical turnaround time from receiving a brief to delivering raw footage?



9. What is your typical pricing structure? Please provide examples if possible.



We are looking for reliable production partners who can grow with us over the long term.



If your team can consistently produce great content, there is potential for a significant amount of ongoing work.

title: Apparel Illustrator / Graphic Designer – Japanese-Inspired Clothing Brand
description:
We are looking for a talented Illustrator / Graphic Designer to create original artwork for an established e-commerce clothing brand.



This is NOT a position for creating ads, social media graphics, website banners, or marketing materials.



Your job will be focused on one thing: creating original artwork and designs that will be printed on clothing.



What We're Looking For



We want someone who is genuinely talented at illustration and design.



Our brand is heavily inspired by Japanese culture and aesthetics, but our designs can vary significantly in style. You should be comfortable adapting to different visual directions rather than being limited to one specific illustration style.



We care much more about the quality of your work and portfolio than how many years of experience you have.



Experience creating artwork for apparel, streetwear, or clothing brands is preferred, but not required.



Your Responsibilities



Your main responsibility will be creating original artwork for our clothing designs.



We will provide concepts, references, ideas, and creative direction for many designs. For some projects, you may also be given more freedom to interpret an idea in your own way.



You should be able to:



* Create original illustrations from scratch

* Work from references and creative direction

* Adapt to different illustration and graphic styles

* Combine illustration, composition, and typography when a design requires it

* Make revisions based on feedback

* Deliver at least 4–5+ quality designs per week

* Prepare artwork suitable for printing on apparel



Knowledge of designing for DTG printing and preparing print-ready artwork is a plus.



What We Care About



We're not looking for someone who can simply use graphic design software.



We're looking for someone who has a strong artistic eye and actual illustration/design ability.



You should understand composition, typography, color, balance, and what makes artwork visually appealing on a T-shirt or other piece of clothing.



Most importantly, you should be able to create original artwork, not simply combine templates or stock graphics. At the very beginning of your application, write the word SAKURA so we know you read the entire job post.



AI tools may be used as part of your creative process when appropriate, but you must have the ability to create and modify artwork yourself. We are not looking for someone who simply generates AI images and submits them as finished designs.



Work Arrangement



We are open to both full-time and part-time applicants.



You can work on your own schedule. We care primarily about communication, reliability, meeting deadlines, and the quality of the designs you deliver. 



There is also opportunity for performance-based bonuses and pay increases for consistently strong work.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid design test before being hired.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions in your application:



1. Tell us about your experience as an illustrator or graphic designer.



2. Have you created designs for clothing, apparel, or streetwear brands before? If yes, please explain what you worked on.



3. What software do you use to create your illustrations and designs?



4. Which illustration/design styles are you strongest at?



5. Are you comfortable creating Japanese-inspired artwork in different styles?



6. Are you able to create original illustrations from scratch?



7. Do you have experience preparing artwork for DTG printing or other apparel printing methods?



8. Do you use AI tools as part of your design process? If yes, explain exactly how you use them.



9. How many high-quality apparel designs do you believe you can realistically complete per week?



10. Are you currently working for another company or client? If yes, approximately how many hours per week?



11. Are you looking for full-time or part-time work?



12. Please provide a link to your portfolio.



Your portfolio is the most important part of your application.



Please send examples that demonstrate your actual illustration and artwork abilities. We are especially interested in apparel graphics, illustrations, streetwear designs, Japanese-inspired artwork, or similar work.



If your portfolio mostly consists of advertisements, social media posts, website banners, Canva designs, or other marketing graphics, this position is probably not the right fit.



Applications without a portfolio or without answers to the questions above will not be considered.



We're looking for someone we can work with long-term who can consistently create strong, original artwork for our brand.

title: Appoinment Setter
description:
We sell AI services to small contractors in the United States — pool builders, fencing companies, HVAC and roofing crews. These are one- and two-man businesses that lose work every day to problems automation solves, starting with missed calls: the owner is on a job site, the phone rings, and the job goes to whoever picked up.



We're hiring one appointment setter to call these owners and book a 30-minute consultation. You are not closing sales. You book the meeting, our team handles the rest.



Responsibilities



Make 200 outbound calls per shift from a provided list of licensed business owners with direct contact numbers

Deliver a short pitch and handle common objections

Book qualified 30-minute appointments into our calendar

Log call outcomes accurately and report your numbers at the end of each shift

What we provide



A US phone number through Dialpad — no equipment purchase needed

A verified lead list. No cold databases, no gatekeepers — you have the owner's name and direct line before you dial.

Script, objection handling guide, and training

Schedule



Monday to Friday, 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM Philippine time (US Pacific business hours)

Permanent night shift, permanent work from home

Compensation



This is a base salary plus uncapped commission, paid in US dollars.



Base: USD $500 per month. Guaranteed, regardless of results. Paid twice a month — on the 15th and the 30th — through Wise, which lands directly in your GCash. You get paid every two weeks like a normal job, not once a month in arrears.



Commission: 5% of every deal that closes. When an appointment you booked turns into a paying client, you get 5% of the setup fee — USD $50 on our standard package, USD $100 on the premium one. There is no cap. Five closed deals in a month is an extra $250–500 on top of your base.



You don't close the sale yourself — our closers do that. Your job is to book the meeting and get the owner to actually show up. Commission is paid on the payout cycle after the client's first payment clears.



Requirements



No calling experience required. We care more about how you sound on the phone and whether you can take rejection than where you've worked.

Clear, neutral English speaking voice

Able to commit to a permanent night shift, 12 AM – 9 AM PHT

Reliable internet (10 Mbps minimum)

Resilient — this role involves constant rejection

How to apply



Applications without a Loom are not reviewed.



Record one Loom (free at loom.com), camera on, two minutes maximum, and answer these in the video:



What's your name and where in the Philippines are you based?

What are you doing right now — are you working, and what are you earning?

Can you commit to 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM Philippine time, Monday to Friday, permanently?

Have you worked a night shift before? How long, and why did you leave the last one?

Why do you think you'd be a great fit for this specific role?

What's your experience — whatever it actually is? No calling background required. If you've never made a cold call, say so straight and tell us what you have done that transfers.

What's the best number you've ever produced — sales, calls, appointments, customers? What did you do to get it?

Give us numbers, not adjectives.

title: Senior Video Editor & Colorist
description:
Hi there! 👋 We're Unrendered Studio, a humble creative studio out of New York. We make strategy, campaigns, and content for health, wellness, and tech brands.



We're lean on purpose. The team is spread across the globe, and we're growing, which is why you're here 😊



One quick note before you scroll: we know job posts usually read like a list of demands. This isn't that. We'd much rather hear from someone excited and honest about where they are than someone who ticks every box on paper.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is the other end of our pipeline from the short-form role. You'd take camera-original footage and build the whole thing: structure, pacing, grade, finish. The work is brand films, campaign pieces, and product content, shot log across a couple of bodies with phone footage mixed in, and it all needs to look like one hand made it.



Right now all of the grading lands on our founder, which isn't where it should sit, so color is the urgent half of this job. The editing is the ongoing half: story-driven cuts, and the graded masters our short-form editors work from.



We know that combination is rare. Plenty of senior editors don't really grade, and plenty of colorists don't cut. If you're strong in one and genuinely solid in the other, apply and tell us which way round you are. 🙂



WHAT YOU'D BE DOING



- Conforming and cutting from camera-original media: log, multicam, phone footage mixed in.

- Building story-driven edits out of unscripted material: interviews, brand films, campaign pieces.

- Grading into a consistent house look, and matching shots across cameras.

- Prepping and delivering graded masters our short-form editors cut from, so what you hand over quietly sets the standard downstream.

- Finishing: cleanup, noise management, titles, captions, sound, delivery renders to spec.

- Working to a written delivery spec with one named approver, so nobody has to guess what "done" means.

- Turning client notes around in 
 and keeping projects inside our naming system.



WHAT WE'RE HOPING YOU BRING



- A reel where both sides show: a cut whose structure is the point, and a grade worth looking at.

- Real command of the Color page in DaVinci Resolve. This is the one thing we can't flex on here.

- Shot matching, which honestly matters more to us than one beautiful hero frame.

- Judgment about what to cut, and the ability to say why in a sentence.

- A calibrated display.

- Steadiness across long projects with several client rounds, and an early heads-up if something slips.

- Comfort working in English.



LOVELY BONUSES



VFX work like roto and compositing, Fusion or general finishing, sound design and mixing, experience with AI-assisted workflows, and an opinion about how to build a house LUT worth keeping.



A WORD ON AI 🤖



AI is part of our production. One strand of our work builds pieces out of generated plates and backgrounds, with characters masked or rotoscoped onto them, then retimed and finished in Resolve. If you've worked on something like that, we'd love to hear about it. If you haven't, that's completely fine; it's a bonus rather than a requirement. We also use Claude or ChatGPT day-to-day for prompts and problem-solving.



A NOTE ON YOUR SETUP 💻



Media is big, and we know bandwidth isn't infinite. Because we work in DaVinci Resolve, we can often host the project in Blackmagic Cloud and sync proxies to you, so you'd pull down small files while the originals stay here for the relink. It isn't guaranteed on every project, but it's a real option.



What we need from you is an honest picture of your internet and storage, which the form asks about. There's no secret cutoff. We're matching workflow to what you've actually got.



DAY TO DAY



You'll live in Dropbox (our main media library), Google Drive, Slack, Notion, 
, and Artlist for music and sound effects. We'll set you up on all of it. Own licenses are ideal; if you don't have them, let's talk.



THE PRACTICAL BITS



Contract. Hours are flexible; you tell us what you can commit. Hourly, monthly retainer, or per project. Remote, time zones flexible, with a little US Eastern overlap preferred.



TOOLS YOU'LL RATE



DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Capture One, Higgsfield. There's also a checklist where you tick everything else you're strong in, including Fusion and Fairlight.



ONE HONEST NOTE



Our new website isn't live yet, so there isn't much to find if you look us up. We're a small studio partway through a rebrand; the work and the clients are real and ongoing, and you'll be dealing with our founder directly from your first message. Ask us anything you want to check, and we'll send work samples.



WE'RE ALSO HIRING



A Video Editor for short-form paid social and organic, and a Graphic Designer & Photo Retoucher. It's the same application form for all three, so just pick the role you want when you get there. And if you'd genuinely take either editor role, there's an option for that too. 🙂



HOW TO APPLY 💛



Send your work (a reel, ideally showing both a cut and a grade) and fill out the application here:





It asks what you'd like to be paid and how many hours you can commit, because we'd rather hear your number than make you guess ours. It also asks about your setup and for a self-rating on the tools above.



About those ratings: no single one rules you out, and nobody's a 4 across the board. We teach our tools and our workflows. What we can't teach is taste and judgment, so that's what we're really hiring for. Your answers just help us plan your first weeks and pick a good first project.



So please be honest. Rounding up doesn't help you, because the paid test shows where you really are anyway, and an accurate rating means we set you up to win. An honest 1 is genuinely more useful to us than a hopeful 3. 🙂



The scale: 0 never used it, 1 beginner, 2 working, 3 fluent, 4 expert.



Then tick anything you'd love to get better at, plus the short checklist of things you've done on paid or organic work. Gaps are expected. Nobody has all of them.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



A real person reads every application. If it looks like a fit, we'll reach out for a short friendly call, then a small paid test project, and hopefully a first real project after that.



Being straight with you: we're small, and in this first round we can only reply to the people we're taking forward. If you haven't heard from us in two weeks, it's a no this time. Once you reach the paid test stage, though, you'll always hear back from us personally, whichever way it goes. 🙂

title: Video Editor for Facebook and Instagram Ads (Short Form, Ecommerce, Long Term)
description:
We knit Van Gogh, Monet, Hokusai and Klimt into organic cotton socks, and we sell them across Europe with
 and Instagram ads. You would cut those ads.



Look at what we make first: 
 and 
/kunstsokken



Full time, long term, fully remote. $1,500 a month depending on experience, plus $150 every single time an ad you cut reaches $5,000 in spend. No cap on that bonus.



Start date: Monday 6 October 2026, sooner if you are free.



ABOUT US



Kunstsokken is a Dutch brand. We license artworks from museums and turn them into socks. Van Gogh, Monet, Hokusai, Klimt, Delft Blue, plus direct collaborations with museums. We are based in the Netherlands. The founders are Tako and Jesse.



We sell online, and paid social is our main growth channel. This role lives inside that.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You turn footage we already own into short ads that stop the scroll.



- Cut 10 to 
 second ads for
 and Instagram.

- Build hooks that land in the first 2 seconds.

- Add burned in captions. We hand you the exact text in Dutch, English, German and French. You do not need to speak any of them. You need to place type carefully and never break a word in the wrong place.

- Mix live footage, product stills with motion, and AI generated shots into one clean cut.

- Deliver the same ad in 9:16, 4:5 and 1:1 when the brief asks. Reframed properly, never stretched.

- Produce alternative hooks for the same ad so we can test the first 2 seconds against each other.

- Edit the occasional Instagram Reel for organic social.



Volume: 8 to 12 finished videos a week, counting hook variants and format versions. Usually 4 to 6 concepts, each shipped in a few cuts.



HOW THE WEEK WORKS



Monday: you get a batch of concept blueprints. Each one has the avatar, the hook, the format, the offer, the landing page and reference ads.

During the week: you ask questions in writing and post rough cuts.

Friday: you deliver the finished batch.

Monday: you get a written scorecard on last week's batch, with the actual ad performance data, plus the new blueprints.



The founder writes the briefs and reviews the work. This is an async role. You will not sit in calls all day. You do have to read a brief properly and ask the right question early instead of guessing.



That Monday scorecard is worth saying twice: you will find out which of your edits made money and which did not. Most editing jobs never tell you.



WHAT YOU GET TO WORK WITH



- A photographer's shot library, with real product and lifestyle footage.

- A separate library of AI generated shots.

- An AI content producer on the team who generates new AI assets on request.

- A photo retoucher who handles product thumbnails, so that is not on your plate.

- A brand kit: fonts, colours, logo, caption scripts, reference ads.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required:

- 2 or more years editing short form video for paid social or ecommerce. Not wedding videos. Not corporate explainers.

- Strong with at least one of: Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut Pro.

- You can show us real ads you cut that actually ran on Meta or TikTok.

- You understand hooks, retention, pattern interrupts, and why the first 2 seconds d
 everything.

- Clean caption work. Correct timing, readable type, inside the safe zones.

- Good written English. You work from written briefs.

- A computer that handles 4K edits, and a stable internet connection.

- You can start on 6 October 2026 and commit long term.



Nice to have:

- Motion graphics and simple 2D animation.

- Sound design and music selection for ads.

- Experience with UGC style ads and creator footage.

- Experience bringing product stills to life with motion, pans and parallax.

- An eye for art, design, or anything visual outside of video.



Not required:

- Filming. We do not need a videographer.

- Dutch or any other language. All copy is supplied.



PAY AND TERMS



- $1,500 to $2,000 per month. Where you land depends on your experience and your trial.

- $150 bonus, one time, for every ad you edited that reaches $5,000 in spend within 90 days of launch. No cap on how many ads can earn it.

- Paid monthly through Wise.

- Freelance contractor. You handle your own taxes.

- Paid trial task before we hire, $60, roughly 3 to 4 hours. We pay for it whether or not we hire you.

- You work on your own machine with your own software. If we ever require a specific paid tool, we pay for it.

- The work you deliver for us belongs to Kunstsokken.

- 30 day review after you start. After that, two weeks notice from either side.



HOW TO APPLY



Read this part carefully. Applications that skip a step are not reviewed.



1. Start your application with the word Sterrennacht. First word, nothing before it.

2. Send a link to 3 to 5 short ads you edited yourself. Not a showreel with client logos. Actual ads.

3. For each one, write one line: what was the brief, and what was the hook.

4. Tell us which editing software you use and how long you have used it.

5. Send a screenshot of a speed test and one line describing your computer.

6. Tell us your time zone and which hours you can overlap with 09:00 to 17:00 Central European Time. We need at least 4 hours of overlap.

7. Tell us your expected monthly rate.

8. Confirm you can start on 6 October 2026.

9. Send one ad you did NOT make that you think is excellent, and say in two sentences why it works.



We reply to every application that follows these steps. Shortlisted candidates get the paid trial task, then a 30 minute video call.
