SCHEDULE AND PAY



40 hours per week. Core hours are 11am to 6pm US Central, Monday to Friday, with weekend coverage discussed based on your availability.

Base pay depends on experience. On top of base, you earn a bonus on every job you book that gets paid, and 10% of the first month's revenue on any commercial or recurring account you source and close yourself. Strong performers earn well above base.



HOW TO APPLY



Put "Blank Space VA" and your full name in the subject line. Answer every item below, numbered, in ONE message. Applications that skip items or send only a cover letter will not be reviewed.



LINK RULES, PLEASE READ: Send your video as a Google Drive, Loom, or YouTube (unlisted) link, set to "Anyone with the link can view." Test it in a private browser window before sending. Do NOT send Vocaroo links, folder links, or links that require me to request access. If I cannot open it in one click, the application is incomplete.



1. A two-minute video introduction in English. Tell me about your most recent phone-based role and what a normal day looked like.



2. A SCREENSHOT (not a link) of your speed test showing both download AND upload. Tell me your city and your backup power and backup internet.



3. The last US cleaning or home services company you worked for, by name, with dates, and the CRM you used there. If you have never worked for one, say so.



4. Are you currently working for another client or another cleaning company? Be honest. Tell me who, how many hours, and what your plans are for that client.



5. What days and hours can you work? Are you open to weekend shifts?



6. In your own words, write your reply to this customer text: "Hi, I need a move-out clean for a 3 bedroom 2 bath apartment this Saturday, how much?"



7. A client texts: "The cleaners did a good job but they missed the baseboards. I want a partial refund." Write your exact reply, word for word.



8. A cleaner arrives at a job booked as 2 bedrooms, 1 bath and finds it is actually 2 bedrooms, 2.5 baths. She calls you from the driveway. What do you do, and what do you tell the client?



9. A caller says he manages 40 apartment units and wants a price for turnover cleans. What do you do?



10. Have you ever recruited or screened cleaners or field workers? How, and how many?



11. Do you speak Spanish? Rate yourself 1 to 10. If not, that is fine.



12. Your expected monthly rate for 40 hours.



We read every complete application personally. Take your time and answer properly. The quality of your application is the first sample of your work.

title: Production & Fulfillment Coordinator
description:
Momento Card Games creates personalized playing cards, trading cards, portrait decks, and keepsakes using real people’s photos, names, memories, and stories.



We’re looking for someone who loves making things clean, correct, organized, and finished.



This role is perfect for someone who enjoys taking a custom order, checking every detail, building it correctly in Canva, sending it to production, tracking it, and making sure the customer receives exactly what they ordered.



You will not be expected to invent new designs every day.



We already have the templates and production system.



Your job is to run that system accurately.



Your main job



Take an approved customer order and move it through:



Order → Canva → Quality Check → Production → Shipping → Delivery



You’ll also handle simple customer communication when information is missing or an order needs an update.



What you’ll do

Review new customer orders

Organize photos, names, text, and order details

Build customer products using our existing Canva templates

Replace photos and text without changing the approved design

Prepare Trading Cards, Photo Decks, Portrait Decks, and packaging

Check spelling, photos, card details, fronts, backs, and packaging

Export the correct production files

Keep files organized in Google Drive

Submit approved orders to our production partner

Track production and shipping

Update order statuses

Contact customers when information is missing or unclear

Help with simple order problems or delivery questions

You’ll probably love this role if…



You’re the person who notices when:



a name is spelled differently

the wrong photo was used

something is slightly misaligned

a file is missing

the wrong card was exported

an order has not moved in a few days



You like checking things off.



You like organized folders.



You like taking something messy and turning it into something finished.



You don’t mind repeatable work when there’s a clear result at the end.



Tools



You’ll work with things like:



Canva

Google Drive

Google Sheets

The Game Crafter


Momento’s production system



You do not need experience with every tool.



You do need to be comfortable learning systems quickly.



What we care about most



We care more about:



accuracy

organization

attention to detail

clear communication

reliability



than advanced graphic-design skills.



You do not need to be a professional designer.



You do need to care when something is wrong.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do not send a long cover letter.



At the very top of your application write:



MOMENTO



Then complete this small exercise.



We made it simple because this is very close to the real work you would do.



Mini Order Test



Imagine this order comes in:



6 personalized Trading Cards



The customer sends:



6 photos

6 names

card details

packaging name

shipping information



You notice:



one photo is blurry

one name is spelled differently in two places

one card is missing information



Please send us:



1. What would you check before production?



Give us a simple checklist.



2. What would you send the customer?



Write the exact message you would send to fix the blurry photo, spelling issue, and missing information.



3. Show us how you stay organized.



Create a simple order tracker showing:



Received → Designing → QC → Production → Shipped → Delivered



A screenshot is fine.



4. Canva example



Send one example of Canva work that shows clean photo placement, text, spacing, and alignment.



That’s it.



What we’re looking for



We’re looking for the person who thinks:



“Let me catch the problem before it becomes the customer’s problem.”



If your application stands out, we’ll send you a $10 paid test using sample Momento assets.



Then:



Application → $10 Paid Test → Paid Trial → Ongoing Role



As Momento grows, this role can grow with it.

title: Video Editor, Short-Form (Paid Social & Organic)
description:
Hi there! 👋 We're Unrendered Studio, a humble creative studio out of New York. We make strategy, campaigns, and content for health, wellness, and tech brands.



We're lean on purpose. The team is spread across the globe, and we're growing, which is why you're here 😊



One quick note before you scroll: we know job posts usually read like a list of demands. This isn't that. We'd much rather hear from someone excited and honest about where they are than someone who ticks every box on paper.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is our volume role, and we mean that as a compliment. You'll cut vertical short-form for TikTok, Reels, and paid ads from footage that's already prepped and color-processed, so no conforming and no grading to worry about. What matters is rhythm, instinct, and making the tenth version as sharp as the first. If you love the craft of a really tight 20-second cut, you'll like it here.



WHAT YOU'D BE DOING



- Cutting short-form for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and paid ads from media that's ready to go.

- Building lots of variants from one idea: different hooks, lengths, aspect ratios.

- Handling captions, sync, music, and sound. Almost everyone watches on a phone with the sound low, so the cut has to work either way.

- Working from our briefs and templates, and telling us when the template is the problem. We really do want to hear that.

- Sending work for review in 
 and keeping to deadlines we agree on together.

- Keeping files tidy in our naming system. We'll walk you through it; it's not scary.



WHAT WE'RE HOPING YOU BRING



- A feel for short-form. You know what stops someone scrolling in the first two seconds.

- Speed that doesn't compromise quality.

- Consistency, so two editors on the same brand still look like one pair of hands.

- Friendly, clear communication, especially when something's going sideways. An early heads-up beats a perfect excuse. 🙂

- Comfort working in English, since briefs and feedback come in English.



LOVELY BONUSES, NOT DEALBREAKERS



DaVinci Resolve (it's what we cut and finish in, and we'll gladly help you get comfortable if you're coming from Premiere or CapCut), captions at volume, simple motion graphics, and experience cutting against a performance brief.



A WORD ON AI 🤖



AI is genuinely part of how we make things here, not a gimmick. For this role, that means generated b-roll and backgrounds, AI voiceover for scratch tracks, generated stills, and upscaling, with Claude or ChatGPT helping write and sharpen the prompts.



You don't need to arrive as an expert. We want you curious and honest about what these tools get wrong. Some of our work sits close to licensed IP, so caring about what's safe to use commercially matters too.



A NOTE ON YOUR SETUP 💻



Our media lives in Dropbox, and the files are big. Before you worry: you don't need a monster machine or fiber internet to work with us. If you cut in DaVinci Resolve, we can often sync proxies to you through Blackmagic Cloud, so you'd pull down small files instead of huge ones. It isn't guaranteed on every project, but it's a real option, and we'll use it where we can.



What we do need is an honest picture of what you're working with, which is why the form asks about your internet, your storage, and your machine. There's no secret cutoff. We're matching the workflow to your setup, not screening you out for it.



DAY TO DAY



You'll live in Dropbox (our main media library), Google Drive, Slack, Notion, 
, and Artlist for music and sound effects. We'll set you up on all of it and expect zero prior experience. If you already have your own software licenses, wonderful. If not, let's talk; we can sort tools out where it makes sense.



THE PRACTICAL BITS



Contract. Hours are flexible; you tell us what you can commit. Hourly, monthly retainer, or per project, whatever suits you. Remote, and we're relaxed about time zones, though a few hours of overlap with US Eastern is lovely when we can get it.



TOOLS YOU'LL RATE



DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Capture One, Higgsfield. There's also a checklist where you tick everything else you're strong in, like CapCut, Fusion, Fairlight, ElevenLabs, or whichever LLM you use.



ONE HONEST NOTE



Our new website isn't live yet, so there isn't much to find if you look us up. We're a small studio partway through a rebrand; the work and the clients are real and ongoing, and you'll be dealing with our founder directly from your first message. Ask us anything you want to check, and we'll send work samples.



WE'RE ALSO HIRING



A Senior Video Editor & Colorist and a Graphic Designer & Photo Retoucher. It's the same application form for all three, so just pick the role you want when you get there. And if you'd genuinely take either editor role, there's an option for that too. 🙂



HOW TO APPLY 💛



Send your work (portfolio or reel) and fill out the application here:





It asks what you'd like to be paid and how many hours you can commit, because we'd rather hear your number than make you guess ours. It also asks about your setup and for a self-rating on the tools above.



About those ratings: no single one rules you out, and nobody's a 4 across the board. We teach our tools and our workflows. What we can't teach is taste and judgment, so that's what we're really hiring for. Your answers just help us plan your first weeks and pick a good first project.



So please be honest. Rounding up doesn't help you, because the paid test shows where you really are anyway, and an accurate rating means we set you up to win. An honest 1 is genuinely more useful to us than a hopeful 3. 🙂



The scale: 0 never used it, 1 beginner, 2 working, 3 fluent, 4 expert.



Then tick anything you'd love to get better at, plus the short checklist of things you've done on paid or organic work. Gaps are expected. Nobody has all of them.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



A real person reads every application. If it looks like a fit, we'll reach out for a short friendly call, then a small paid test project, and hopefully a first real project after that.



Being straight with you: we're small, and in this first round we can only reply to the people we're taking forward. If you haven't heard from us in two weeks, it's a no this time. Once you reach the paid test stage, though, you'll always hear back from us personally, whichever way it goes. 🙂

title: YouTube Documentary Outline Writer
description:
⚠️ PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING:



Please read the full post before applying. We’re looking for someone who understands the role, not generic applications.

If you’ve read this, start your application with “I READ THE BRIEF” and follow the instructions under How to Apply.

Applications that don’t follow the instructions may not be considered.



—



I’m Shane, the creator behind Repzilla. I’m looking for a YouTube outline writer who can turn my research into engaging documentary and commentary storylines that I can follow while recording. 



Research is provided: I supply the main notes, receipts, sources, and some analysis. You organize the narrative, develop the reasoning, and give me a clear path to speak in my own words.



The intended video length is around 60 minutes or more when the evidence supports it. Some projects combine several related stories; others examine one person’s claims, conduct, or influence. We will not pad a story to reach a runtime.





WHAT YOU WILL DO:



Build the story. Plan the opening, chapter sequence, connecting points, and conclusion. Develop the facts and explanations into a storyline the audience can follow, including how separate i
 connect when relevant.



Prepare the recording outline. Use developed talking points, clear section headings, and receipt or clip cues. Explain the point of each section and how to move to the next. Suggest exact wording where precision matters; an outline is the required deliverable.



Handle evidence carefully. Keep source links, receipt references, exact quotations, dates, and timestamps attached to the relevant claims. Flag gaps and preserve context that affects the interpretation.



Think independently. Identify genuine contradictions and weak reasoning, including problems in my own interpretation. Explain what the evidence establishes and what remains uncertain.





THE JUDGMENT THIS ROLE REQUIRES:



For an apparent contradiction, compare the actual statements, dates, meanings, and circumstances. A changed position is not automatically dishonesty. Explain a misleading inference in plain language; naming a logical fallacy is not enough. A weak argument does not, by itself, prove its conclusion false.



When discussing potential harm, identify the specific conduct, who could be affected, and how the harm could occur. Separate documented outcomes from plausible risks. Preserve material responses and alternative explanations. Do not strengthen a claim beyond the evidence just to make the story more dramatic.





TO APPLY:



Send two relevant long-form outlines or writing samples, preferably with the finished videos, and explain exactly which parts you created. 



Tell us how you turn supplied research into a usable storyline and describe a time you caught a misleading claim or changed a story’s interpretation.



Include your quote for a production-ready outline, availability, and expected turnaround after reviewing a sample research packet. 



Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid outline test and explain their choices in a brief walkthrough. Project scope and deadlines will be agreed before work begins.



If you’ve read the entire job post, reply with the word “I READ THE BRIEF” at the beginning of your application.

title: Business Loan Sales Consultant / Closer — Warm Leads — AU Day Shift
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Have you sold business loans, mortgages, asset finance or insurance? Bring your closing experience to Ezy Pzy Finance and help Australian business owners access funding.

We also welcome proven sales professionals from other industries who can demonstrate consistent target achievement and experience closing business over the phone.

You’ll receive warm enquiries, product training, weekly coaching and the opportunity to earn commission on both new and repeat clients.





YOUR EARNING OPPORTUNITY



•During probation: AUD $500/week + commissions + bonuses (approx. ₱97,500/month fixed base). After 8 weeks probation: AUD $650/week including PhilCare allowance + commissions (approx. ₱126,750/month fixed pay).

• Our agents currently average AUD $5,200/month (₱234,000/month) in total earnings including commissions and monthly bonuses.

• Earn between AUD $100 - $800 (approximately ₱4,500–₱36,000) commission per deal..

• Repeat business stays with you: when a client you funded returns for more funding, you handle their next deal and earn commission again.

• Earn additional monthly performance bonuses based on KPI’s achieved.

After your two-month probation, benefits include the base salary increase, an HMO allowance, paid annual and sick leave, and access to higher bonus tiers.





WHO WE ARE



Ezy Pzy Finance is a fast growing Australian business finance company connecting business owners with a panel of non-bank lenders.

We’re growing our remote sales team and looking for consultants who combine strong closing skills with clear communication and disciplined follow-up.

Learn more: 





WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Call Australian business owners who have already expressed interest in funding.

• Understand their business, funding needs and timing.

• Qualify enquiries and guide clients through the application process.

• Explain available options clearly, handle objections and move deals towards settlement.

• Keep your pipeline organised and follow up consistently.

• Build relationships that generate repeat business.



Warm leads are provided. There is no cold prospecting or list building, but the role involves regular outbound calls and persistent follow-up.





WHO SHOULD APPLY



You have at least two years of phone-based sales experience and have personally been responsible for closing sales and achieving targets.



We particularly welcome sales experience in:



• Business lending or merchant cash advance campaigns.

• Australian or US mortgage and asset finance.

• Insurance, debt solutions or other financial products.



Successful closers from other industries are also encouraged to apply. Show us what you sold, your targets, your results and your role in winning the business.



You should be able to:



• Build trust and communicate confidently in spoken English.

• Run a discovery conversation and ask useful follow-up questions.

• Explain products clearly and handle objections professionally.

• Own your pipeline, maintain accurate records and follow through.

• Learn new products and apply coaching.



Finance processing, customer service or appointment-setting experience is useful, but you must also demonstrate personal closing experience.





TRAINING AND SUPPORT



Your first four weeks include structured product and sales training, with an initial focus on smaller loan facilities up to approximately A$30,000.

You’ll progress to larger deals as you meet quality and settlement milestones, supported by weekly one-to-one sales coaching.





SCHEDULE AND SETUP



• Monday–Friday, 6:30am–4:30pm Philippine time.

• One-hour lunch break; 45 working hours/week.

• Fully remote, with evenings free.

• Reliable computer, internet connection and backup internet/power arrangements required.





HOW TO APPLY



Incomplete applications will not be considered. Complete applications get a response within 48 hours.

Provide ALL 5 of the following:

A short video (3–5 minutes, Loom / Google Drive / unlisted YouTube link) in two parts:



Part 1 — introduce yourself, your sales experience, and the results/KPIs you achieved (numbers, not adjectives).



Part 2 — a 2-minute mock opening of a discovery call: pretend you’ve just dialled an Australian business owner from Ezy Pzy Finance — do your opening, build rapport, and start qualifying them for funding.



- Link to your resume.

- Screenshots of your DISC assessment and IQ test results (tests available at 
/testcontent).

- Screenshot of your internet speed test, provider, and PC/laptop specs.

- Your backup internet and power solutions.

- Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a Zoom interview, including a live discovery-call role-play.





If you’re a top performing sales professional and have the self drive to earn big commissions and grow in a company that is focused on long term success, then submit your application and we’ll see if we’re a good fit to work together.

title: Motion & Media Support
description:
Motion & Media Support

Full-time | Remote (Philippines) | US$280 per week | Monday–Friday



An Australian fashion / lifestyle DTC brand is looking for a Motion & Media Support hire to lead video editing across the marketing team's content output.



This role sits within Marketing & Creative and works closely with the Social/Content team, the founder, and campaign leads to turn raw footage into fast, engaging, on-brand video — from campaign launches through to everyday social and organic content.



The Opportunity

Pay: US$280 per week (fixed advertised rate; US$7.00 per hour).

Arrangement: Full-time remote contractor engagement, 40 hours per week.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm (aligned to Australian business hours).

Start: As soon as practical. Please include your earliest start date and any notice period.

The advertised rate is fixed. Please only apply if you are comfortable with the compensation and schedule.



What you'll be responsible for

1. Campaign content — Cutting reels from campaign launch content, with a focus on hero products.

2. In-house face to camera — Cutting and editing in-house face-to-camera content (founder/talent or Social team) into publish-ready pieces.

3. Influencer content — Cutting and editing influencer content, splitting multi-look reels into individual posts for organic and paid use.

4. Stop motion — Creating stop-motion content for social hype and brand-building filler content.

5. Reactive / lower-lift content — Fast-turnaround editing of raw or lookbook footage into stories and in-the-moment posts, prioritising speed over polish.

6. Paid ad creative — Cutting multiple hook/variation edits of the same footage for A/B testing across paid social, and resizing winning organic content for paid placements.

7. Event and activation content — On-the-ground and same-day editing from activations, launches, and store openings/events for near real-time posting.

8. UGC, customer and employee content — Sourcing, editing, and repackaging customer, creator, and employee-generated content into social- and paid-ready formats.

9. Cross-channel repurposing — Adapting core footage across social, EDM/email banners/GIFs, website product and campaign video, and long-format channels.

10. Templates and batching — Building reusable cut-down templates and presets (intros, product callouts, transitions) to support higher-volume, faster-turnaround content.



Must-haves

- Fluent English (spoken and written) — required. You must communicate clearly with an Australian marketing and creative team.

- Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating social-first video editing, ideally fashion, lifestyle, or DTC retail.

- Software proficiency: Adobe, CapCut, Figma, Canva; After Effects for motion graphics, titles, and typography.

- Platform know-how across 9:16, 1:1, and 16:9 formats.

- Motion graphics within existing brand templates and visual identity (not needing full creative direction for every asset).

- Comfortable with high content volume and fast turnaround in a deadline-driven environment.

- Asset management: organising, logging, and archiving raw footage from shoots, influencer sends, studio days, and campaigns.

- Collaboration: working closely with digital and Social/Content teams, following briefs, and turning around feedback quickly.

- Sound design & music licensing awareness for social (royalty-free / trending-sound workarounds).

- Basic photography/videography for supplementary content on set, in office, or in store.



How to apply

Apply with your CV, portfolio/reel link, and brief answers:

1) Confirm fluent spoken and written English for an Australian creative team (Yes/No).

2) Share your best social-first video portfolio/reel (fashion/lifestyle/DTC preferred).

3) Which tools do you use day-to-day (Adobe, CapCut, After Effects, Figma, Canva, others)?

4) Describe a high-volume or fast-turnaround edit you owned end-to-end.

5) Confirm you can work Mon–Fri 9:00am–5:00pm AU hours at US$280 per week. Earliest start date?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a brief screen and meet the team. Applications are being reviewed now.

title: Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist
description:
Location: Remote (Full or partial US hours overlap required)



About OpenCall 



OpenCall's voice AI handles calls for multi-location medical groups. We're solving a unique challenge: pushing the limits of AI at millisecond performance to have the best human-like customer service experience at enterprise scale. Our AI is faster, cheaper, more powerful, and more reliable than anything else on the market. We let businesses answer the phone and make outbound calls automatically—answering questions, booking appointments, and integrating directly with existing booking software.



We are looking for a Quality Assurance Specialist who can rigorously pressure-test our AI agents and ensure they consistently deliver a flawless, human-like conversational experience for the medical and dental practices we serve. 



About the role



As a Quality Assurance Specialist at OpenCall, you are the final line of defense ensuring our AI voice agents sound natural, respond accurately, and navigate complex conversations flawlessly. This is a highly impactful, non-engineering role focused entirely on conversational quality and product reliability.



You will rigorously test both our inbound and outbound phone agents, actively trying to break them by introducing edge cases, unexpected questions, and complex medical scheduling scenarios. You will ensure our AI can handle the unpredictable nature of real human conversations before deployments go live for our medical and dental practices.



Responsibilities



- Conversational Testing: Conduct extensive manual testing of inbound and outbound AI voice agents over the phone, simulating real-world patient interactions, objections, and edge cases.



- Issue Identification & Reporting: Document bugs, prompt failures, unnatural pauses, and conversational dead-ends. You will translate these conversational breakdowns into clear, actionable reports for our engineering and prompt development teams.



- Call Auditing & Grading: Listen to and review call recordings and transcripts from live and test environments to grade AI performance against our strict quality and safety standards.



- Collaborative Iteration: Work closely with Agent Developers and Customer Success Managers to understand customer-specific workflows (like complex dental scheduling rules) and verify that the AI adheres to those precise constraints.



What we're looking for

- Extensive QA or relevant experience: You have 5+ years of experience in quality assurance, conversational design testing, contact center operations, or a highly rigorous analytical role.



- Exceptional English fluency: Because you are evaluating the nuances of spoken English—including tone, register, phrasing, and regional accents—native-level or highly fluent English speaking and listening skills are an absolute requirement.



- Meticulous attention to detail: You notice the subtle difference between an AI sounding "helpful" versus "robotic," and you possess the focus required to run through dozens of conversational flows without letting small errors slip through the cracks.



- Tech-savvy problem solver: You do not need to be an engineer or write code, but you must be highly comfortable working alongside technical teams, navigating internal dashboards, and utilizing modern software tools to log your findings.



Preferred Qualifications

- Full overlap with US business hours (partial overlap is acceptable for the ideal candidate).

- Prior experience testing voice AI, chatbots, LLMs, or working in conversational AI.

- Familiarity with healthcare operations, medical/dental scheduling workflows, or terminology.

About Metrix



Metrix is an Australian tattoo supply brand focused on high-quality products for professional tattoo artists. We are a growing, design-led business with a strong focus on quality, consistency and building genuine relationships with artists.



We’re looking for a Graphic Designer & Digital Marketing Specialist to join our team remotely and take ownership of much of our day-to-day creative and digital marketing.



This is a hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between design, social media, content creation,
 marketing and digital campaigns — and who understands how to create content that actually gets attention, rather than simply making things look good.



The Role



You’ll be responsible for bringing the Metrix brand to life across digital channels.



You’ll work closely with the founders and wider team to develop creative campaigns, social content, product launches and marketing materials, while helping us grow our online presence and customer base.



We’re looking for someone who is creative, commercially minded and proactive. You should be able to take a brief and run with it, but also be confident bringing your own ideas to the table.



Key Responsibilities



Graphic Design



* Create engaging visual content for Instagram, TikTok,
 and other digital channels

* Design social media posts, Reels covers, stories, ads and promotional graphics

* Develop creative assets for product launches and marketing campaigns

* Design
 marketing graphics and promotional materials

* Create product and campaign imagery for our website and online store

* Develop printed materials when required, including flyers, product cards, brochures and trade show materials

* Maintain consistency across all Metrix branding and visual communications

* Work with existing brand guidelines while continuing to develop and evolve the visual identity



Social Media & Content



* Plan and create content for Metrix’s social media channels

* Help develop a consistent and engaging content calendar

* Create content around our products, artists, brand story and tattoo industry

* Identify trends and opportunities for relevant social content

* Assist with Reels and TikTok concepts, including editing where required

* Coordinate and repurpose user-generated content and artist content

* Help grow engagement and strengthen Metrix’s relationship with professional tattoo artists



Digital Marketing



* Assist with planning and executing digital marketing campaigns

* Create creative assets for Meta and other paid advertising campaigns

* Monitor campaign performance and use data to inform future creative

* Assist with
 marketing, including campaign creation, graphics and basic reporting

* Support product launches and promotional campaigns across our website,
 and social channels

* Assist with website content and merchandising when required

* Track relevant marketing metrics and report on performance



Brand & Campaign Development



* Help develop creative concepts for new product launches

* Work with the team to develop campaigns from initial idea through to execution

* Bring fresh ideas for how Metrix can stand out within the tattoo industry

* Research competitors, industry trends and relevant cultural/social trends

* Help maintain a consistent, premium and professional brand presence across all touchpoints



What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who has:



* Strong graphic design skills and a good eye for typography, composition and visual hierarchy

* Experience creating content for social media

* Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator

* Experience with video editing, particularly short-form content for Reels and TikTok

* An understanding of digital marketing and social media strategy

* Strong attention to detail

* Good written English and communication skills

* The ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines

* A proactive approach — you don’t need to be told what to do every step of the way

* An understanding of how design and marketing work together to achieve commercial results

* An interest in culture, fashion, art, music, tattooing or other creative industries



Ideally, You Also Have



* Experience working with an e-commerce brand

* Experience with Shopify

* Experience with Meta Ads Manager

* Experience with Klaviyo or another
 marketing platform

* Experience creating UGC-style or talking-to-camera content

* Experience working with influencers, creators or brand ambassadors

* Experience in the tattoo, beauty, fashion, lifestyle or creative industries

* Basic understanding of marketing analytics and conversion metrics



The Person



This role would suit someone who is creative but commercially minded.



We don’t want someone who simply waits for a brief and produces a graphic. We want someone who notices opportunities and says:



“We should be doing this.”



You should be comfortable working independently, managing your own workload and communicating regularly with a remote team.



You’ll need to be able to balance creativity with the practical side of marketing — understanding that a beautiful piece of content is great, but ultimately we want to build the Metrix brand, grow our audience and sell products.



What We Offer



* Fully remote position

* Flexible working environment

* Work with an established Australian tattoo brand

* Opportunity to have genuine creative input into the direction of the brand

* Variety across graphic design, social media, content and digital marketing

* Opportunity to grow with the business

* Work closely with the founders and have a direct impact on the brand

title: B2B Graphic & Brand Designer (10-20hrs/wk)

title: Senior Accountant (AU Accounting Firm)
description:
Senior Accountant (AU Accounting Firm) – Complex Balance Sheets & SME Year-End Specialist

Engagement Type: Full Working Week Contractor (6-8hrs daily required)



Your availability: Australian Business Hours (AEST / AEDT) – No night shifts!



Salary Range: PHP 60,000 – PHP 90,000+ / month 



About Us

We are a growing, client-focused accounting firm based in Australia, servicing a diverse portfolio of Small to Medium Enterprises (SMEs). We pride ourselves on delivering accurate, high-quality end-of-period bookkeeping and reporting, advisory-level financial insight, and seamless compliance.



We are expanding our team and seeking a highly capable, detail-obsessed Senior Accountant who thrives on complex balance sheet reconciliations and preparing accurate year-end financial files.



Key Responsibilities

Complex Balance Sheet Reconciliations: Perform deep-dive reconciliations including intercompany transactions, loan accounts, division 7A considerations, fixed asset registers, and deferred tax assets/liabilities.



End-of-Period & Year-End Compliance: Prepare accurate Year-End Workpapers, General Purpose Financial Statements, and pre Tax Returns preparations (Company, Trust, Partnership, Sole Trader) to Australian standards.



BAS / IAS Preparation: Review and prepare Business Activity Statements and Monthly/Quarterly IAS filings, ensuring full GST reconciliation.



Review & Quality Control: Interrogate trial balances to catch discrepancies, incorrect postings, or missing accruals/prepayments before partner review.



Client & Software Systems Management: Work fluidly across cloud software (Xero, MYOB, QuickBooks) and practice management tools (e.g., Xero Practice Manager, Lodgeit) .



Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: Minimum 3–5+ years of hands-on experience working in an Australian public accounting practice (offshore or BPO experience accepted).



Technical Mastery: Superior understanding of Australian Tax Law, GST rules, Division 7A, and SME balance sheet structures.



Software Proficiency: Advanced skills in Xero (Xero Tax / XPM experience highly regarded), Excel (pivot tables, complex formulas), and cloud accounting apps.



Attention to Detail: Proven ability to deliver clean, review-ready working paper files with minimal partner intervention.



Communication: Excellent written and verbal English skills to collaborate smoothly with our Australian-based team.



Work Setup: Reliable home office setup with high-speed internet (plus backup), noise-canceling headset, and a dedicated workspace.



Why Join Us?

Competitive Contractor Rates: Above-market pay with performance-based reviews and bonuses.

Great Work-Life Balance: Australian daytime working hours—enjoy your evenings and weekends off.



Professional Growth: Direct collaboration with experienced Australian CPAs/CAs and continuous training.



Long-Term Stability: Full-time, long-term employment with a supportive, respectful team culture.



How to Apply

To apply, please reply to this post and include:



A copy of your updated CV (PDF format).



A brief summary (dot points) detailing your experience with complex balance sheet reconciliations and Australian year-end tax returns.



The main accounting software and tax preparation tools you have mastered.



Your expected monthly salary in PHP and earliest available start date.

title: Mechanical Product Design / CAD Engineer – Thin Smart Consumer Product Prototype | SolidWorks / Fusion 360
description:
HappyMat™️ is seeking a mechanical/product design engineer in the Philippines to engineer the physical architecture of a new smart consumer-product prototype.



The product is approximately 30 × 18 inches with a target thickness of 1.25 inches or less, incorporating electronics, sensors, a display, perimeter lighting, camera/audio components and a removable/replaceable upper mat surface.



Responsibilities include: mechanical architecture; CAD modeling; electronics packaging; display and sensor mounting; LED perimeter/diffuser integration; removable/serviceable electronics access; cable routing and strain relief; non-slip base design; splash-resistant enclosure concepts; and preparation of fabrication/3D-print/CNC-ready files.



This is Prototype #1. We are not seeking production tooling yet. The objective is a professional functional proof-of-concept that can later transition into DFM and production engineering.



Preferred experience: SolidWorks and/or Fusion 360; consumer-product enclosure design; electronics packaging; 3D printing/CNC/prototype fabrication; plastics/elastomers; gasket/sealing concepts; LED diffusers/light pipes; DFM.



To apply:



1. Show 3 examples of physical products/enclosures you personally designed.

2. Include CAD screenshots and photographs of the fabricated result where possible.

3. Explain your role in each project.

4. Which CAD platform do you use?

5. Have you packaged electronics into thin consumer products?

6. Do you have relationships with prototype/3D-print/CNC shops in the Philippines?

7. What city are you located in?

8. Are you willing to sign an NDA?



Start your proposal with “HAPPYMAT MECHANICAL.”

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back

title: Executive Assistant to CEO & COO
description:
Executive Assistant to CEO & COO



Company: Free Life Wellness Center

Position: Executive Assistant to CEO & COO

Schedule: Full-Time, Monday–Friday

Hours: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Arizona Time

Location: Remote

Reports To: CEO

Supports: CEO/CFO and COO



About the Role



Free Life Wellness Center is looking for a highly organized, proactive, dependable Executive Assistant to support our CEO and COO and help keep the administrative side of our organization running smoothly.



This person will serve as a key administrative partner to leadership and a central point of organization for Free Life. Your primary responsibility is simple: keep leadership organized, communication moving, administrative systems maintained, and important tasks from falling through the cracks.



The position primarily supports our CEO, who also oversees the company's financial operations, while also providing administrative and project support to our COO in operations, HR, and compliance.



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply wait to be told what to do. We want someone who notices what needs to happen, keeps track of details, follows through, and gradually learns to anticipate the needs of leadership.



Key Responsibilities



Executive Support



-Manage the CEO's calendar, meetings, appointments, invitations, and scheduling.

-Monitor and organize the CEO's
 inbox.

-Draft and respond to routine
s on behalf of the CEO.

-Identify urgent matters and flag items requiring the CEO's direct attention or decision.

-Maintain a running list of items requiring CEO follow-up, approval, or decision.

-Prepare agendas, documents, reminders, and background information for meetings.

-Attend selected meetings, take notes, document action items, and coordinate follow-up.

-Follow up with leadership and team members regarding outstanding assignments.

-Help protect the CEO's time by determining what can be handled independently and what truly requires CEO involvement.

-Assist with administrative components of financial, vendor, contract, and business matters as directed by the CEO.



Shared Inbox & Communication Management



-Monitor the organization's Admin and Info
 inboxes throughout the business day.

-Respond to routine inquiries using approved responses and established procedures.

-Route clinical, HR, billing, referral, scheduling, compliance, and other inquiries to the appropriate team member.

-Flag urgent, sensitive, or executive-level matters for leadership.

-Follow up when
s have been forwarded to ensure requests are addressed.

-Maintain organized shared inboxes using folders, labels, archiving, and other systems.

-Identify recurring questions and help develop templates or processes to improve efficiency.



Administrative Systems & Organization



-Help organize and maintain Free Life's Google Drive and shared electronic files.

-Maintain clear folder structures, naming conventions, and document organization.

-Help ensure staff are accessing current versions of forms, templates, policies, and resources.

-Organize and maintain the company's internal intranet/resource center.

-Upload and organize policies, procedures, forms, training resources, leadership documents, and staff resources.

-Maintain company calendars, directories, contact lists, templates, trackers, and recurring administrative resources.

-Help create systems that make information easier for staff and leadership to locate.

-Periodically review administrative systems and identify items that need to be updated, reorganized, or archived.



COO, HR & Compliance Support



-Provide administrative support to the COO with operational, HR, and compliance projects.

-Coordinate meetings, trainings, onboarding activities, orientations, and leadership follow-ups.

-Assist with organizing HR and compliance documents and trackers.

-Track deadlines and outstanding administrative items.

-Send reminders and follow up with team members regarding requested information.

-Assist with audit and compliance preparation.

-Help maintain recurring operational and compliance calendars.

-Assist with onboarding and offboarding administrative tasks as assigned.

-Support the COO with maintaining organized records, documents, and internal resources.



Meetings & Follow-Through



-Coordinate internal and external meetings.

-Send calendar invitations, Zoom links, reminders, and meeting materials.

-Attend designated leadership or project meetings.

-Take clear meeting notes and identify decisions, assignments, owners, and deadlines.

-Send follow-up communication after meetings when needed.

-Maintain an action-item tracker and follow up with responsible team members.

-Bring unresolved or overdue matters back to the appropriate executive.



Special Projects & Marketing Support



-Assist with special projects for Free Life Wellness Center and affiliated business initiatives.

-Provide light administrative and marketing support for Free Life Fit as assigned.

-Assist with social media scheduling, marketing materials, event promotion, website updates, and content organization.

-Coordinate invitations, community events, promotional activities, and outreach projects.



Must-Haves

✅ Excellent English, written and spoken — you will communicate with employees, partners, and others on behalf of leadership.

✅ Extremely organized — you enjoy checklists, systems, calendars, and keeping information organized.

✅ Reliable — you show up on time, communicate, and do what you say you will do.

✅ Strong follow-through — you don't need to be repeatedly reminded about assignments.

✅ Good judgment — you can learn what needs executive attention and what can be handled independently.

✅ Tech-savvy — you can quickly learn new tools and systems, including Google Workspace, Zoom, and other business platforms.

✅ Professional and discreet — you understand that you may have access to confidential business, employee, financial, and healthcare-related information.

✅ Available 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Arizona Time, Monday–Friday.

 address listed in this posting.

title: Medical Biller - US Home Health Agency (Florida Medicaid / Private Duty Nursing)
description:
Full-time, Permanent work-from-home, US Eastern Time hours, $1,200 USD/month



Home Heart Florida is a pediatric private duty nursing agency. Our nurses care for medically fragile children in their homes across Florida. We are hiring an experienced medical biller to own our billing end-to-end: claim submission, denial management, payment posting, and EVV problem-solving.



This is not an entry-level or general "medical billing VA" role. We are looking for someone who has personally billed Florida Medicaid home health / private duty nursing claims - hourly nursing codes, managed care plans, EVV, clearinghouses, appeals. If you have done this work, this job will feel familiar on day one. If you haven't, please don't apply - we screen for it specifically.



You will:

- Build and submit weekly claim batches (hourly PDN claims: S9123, S9124, S9122)

- Work denials: research the reason, fix and resubmit, file reconsiderations and disputes, and never let a timely-filing or appeal deadline pass

- Post payments from 835 remittance files and reconcile what's paid vs outstanding

- Resolve EVV holds so visits can bill (HHA eXchange and Tellus/Netsmart)

- Manage special billing paths, including manual 837 claim-file uploads to a payer portal

- Run eligibility checks and keep a clean action log of every claim you touch



You must have:

- 2+ years hands-on US medical billing, with home health or private duty nursing experience in Florida Medicaid managed care (Sunshine Health, Molina, Simply/Anthem, Wellcare or similar)

- Working knowledge of hourly nursing HCPCS codes (S9123, S9124, S9122) and what EVV is and why it blocks payment

- Experience with HHA eXchange and/or Tellus / Netsmart - you know what these are without Googling

- Clearinghouse experience - Waystar strongly preferred

- Confidence reading an 835/EOB and explaining a denial code in plain English

- Excellent written English, extreme attention to detail, and the persistence to chase a claim for months until it pays

- Reliable computer and internet, and availability during US Eastern Time business hours



Nice to have: Availity, appeals/dispute writing, Excel skills, experience at a US home care agency that went through a payer transition.



Pay and setup: $1,200 USD/month, full-time, permanent work-from-home, direct hire (not an agency). Long-term role with a stable, growing company.



How to apply (follow exactly, we filter on this):

Apply using the Apply button on this page. Put the word LEDGER in the subject line of your application, and include:

1. Your resume

2. A 2-minute video (Loom or similar): walk us through one denied claim you personally worked, from denial to resolution - what the denial was, what you did, how it ended

3. Written answers to these 6 questions (short answers are fine):

   a. Which nursing discipline does code S9124 bill for, and what is its RN counterpart code?

   b. In 1-2 sentences: what is the difference between an 837 and an 835?

   c. Which EVV systems or aggregators have you personally worked in? Name them.

   d. Which Florida Medicaid health plans have you billed? Name them.

   e. A claim denies CO-18 (duplicate). What is the first thing you check?

   f. What does timely filing mean, and what happens if you miss the window?

4. Confirm you can work US Eastern Time hours



Applications that skip the video, the questions, or the subject-line word are not reviewed.

What We Offer:

title: Customer Support Specialist — Trillet AI
description:
About Trillet AI



Trillet AI builds AI voice agents for businesses. Our customers use our platform for phone agents, integrations, and day-to-day operations. Support is how we keep trust when something is unclear or broken.



The role



You own the customer support queue end to end. You will work in Jira (SUP- tickets), reply to customers by
, learn our product deeply, and know when to solve an issue yourself versus escalate to engineering. After you escalate, you chase engineering until the issue is fixed and SLAs are met.



This is not a “log a ticket and wait” job. You own the customer experience until the ticket is closed.



Responsibilities



Triage and prioritise incoming support tickets and related customer
s

Reply to customers clearly and professionally: diagnose, explain, guide, and close the loop

Build strong product knowledge so answers are accurate, not generic

Resolve what support can resolve (how-tos, configuration, known workarounds, account admin)

Escalate cleanly to engineering when it is a bug, outage, data/security issue, or needs a code change — with clear steps to reproduce, impact, urgency, and what you already tried

After escalation: follow up with engineering, protect response and resolution SLAs, and keep the customer updated without overpromising

Keep Jira accurate (status, comments, priority, links)

Spot repeat issues and flag them for product and engineering

What success looks like



Fast, accurate first responses; customers rarely need to chase you

Engineering only receives well-scoped tickets

Open tickets do not go stale; SLAs are visible and met

You correctly judge support fix vs engineering needed

Leadership does not need to babysit the queue

Requirements



2+ years in customer support, technical support, or customer success for a SaaS product

Comfortable using Jira (or similar ticketing tools) as your main system

Excellent written English — clear, calm, and professional under pressure

Strong attention to detail and follow-through

Able to learn a technical product, reproduce issues, and communicate clearly with engineers

Good judgment: escalate at the right time, then chase until done

Organised, reliable, and SLA-minded

Able to work overlapping Australian business hours

Nice to have



Experience with voice/telephony, AI tools, CRM systems, or SaaS integrations

Prior work bridging support and engineering in a startup or small team

Experience supporting customers in AU/NZ or similar markets

What this role is not



Not a sales role (you may route commercial questions; you do not invent pricing)

Not an engineering role (you diagnose, escalate, and follow up; you do not ship code)

Not a passive ticket logger (silence on open tickets is failure)

How to apply



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph with:



A short introduction about yourself

Your relevant support experience

Your English writing sample (or a sample customer reply you have written)

Your available working hours in Philippine time and how they overlap with Australia

Your expected monthly rate (USD or PHP)

Only serious, long-term applicants please.

Key Responsibilities

title: Wholesale Sales & CRM Virtual Assistant – U.S. Gift & Retail Market
description:
Company: National Park Magic

Position: Remote | Part-Time

Hours: Approximately 15–20 hours per week to start, with opportunity to grow

Pay: $5–$7 USD/hour, depending on experience

Schedule: Some availability during U.S. business hours required



About National Park Magic



National Park Magic is a growing U.S.-based gift company creating high-quality ornaments and gifts inspired by America’s most beloved national parks and iconic destinations.



Our products are sold directly to consumers as well as through boutiques, gift shops, museum stores, visitor centers, and specialty retailers throughout the United States.



We are looking for a smart, dependable, highly organized person who can become an important part of our small team and help us grow.



About the Role



We are hiring a Wholesale Sales & CRM Virtual Assistant to help manage three important areas of our business:



1. Finding and developing new wholesale customers

2. Managing communication and follow-up with prospective and existing wholesale accounts

3. Helping us stay extremely organized with both wholesale and retail orders



This is not primarily a data-entry position.



We need someone who is confident communicating with U.S. retail buyers, writes excellent professional English, follows up consistently, and is comfortable taking ownership of an organized sales pipeline.



You will help identify potential retailers, introduce them to National Park Magic, follow up with them, maintain our HubSpot CRM, assist with orders, and make sure opportunities and customer needs never fall through the cracks.



We are a small business, so we are especially looking for someone who is proactive. We do not want to have to remind you to follow up with a customer or ask you whether an order still needs attention. We want someone who enjoys creating systems, staying organized, and taking responsibility for their work.



Wholesale Sales Outreach



You will:



• Research and identify boutiques, gift shops, museum stores, visitor centers, national park-area retailers, specialty stores, and other potential wholesale customers throughout the United States.

• Identify the appropriate buyer, owner, merchandise manager, or wholesale contact whenever possible.

• Find and organize accurate contact information for prospective accounts.

• Send personalized cold outreach
s introducing National Park Magic and our wholesale collection.

• Customize outreach based on the retailer, location, and products that may be most relevant to them.

• Maintain a consistent follow-up schedule with prospective retailers.

• Follow up professionally without allowing promising leads to be forgotten.

• Respond promptly and professionally to incoming wholesale inquiries.

• Help turn interested retailers into first-time wholesale customers.



Wholesale Customer Relationships



Once a retailer becomes a customer, we want to build a long-term relationship with them.



You will:



• Maintain communication with existing wholesale customers.

• Follow up after orders are delivered to confirm that everything arrived correctly.

• Check in with retailers several weeks after delivery when appropriate.

• Ask about inventory levels and potential replenishment needs.

• Encourage repeat orders through thoughtful, professional communication.

• Keep track of important customer details and previous conversations.

• Make sure customer questions and concerns receive timely responses.

• Help us provide the type of personal service that makes retailers want to continue working with National Park Magic.



CRM & Sales Pipeline Management



HubSpot will be a central part of this position.



You will:



• Maintain an accurate and organized HubSpot CRM.

• Record prospective and existing wholesale accounts.

• Log outreach,
s, responses, notes, and important customer information.

• Track where each prospect is within the sales process.

• Create and maintain follow-up tasks.

• Update the status of leads as conversations progress.

• Make sure every interested prospect has a clear next step.

• Keep the CRM clean and accurate so we can easily understand the health of our wholesale pipeline.



Our goal is simple: no promising customer, inquiry, or follow-up should ever fall through the cracks.



Retail & Wholesale Order Management



You will also help us stay organized with orders.



Responsibilities may include:



• Monitor both retail and wholesale orders.

• Maintain an accurate order tracker.

• Assist with entering wholesale orders accurately.

• Verify important order and customer information.

• Monitor outstanding and pending orders.

• Identify orders that may be delayed or require attention.

• Help communicate order updates to customers when necessary.

• Flag problems immediately rather than waiting for us to discover them.

• Help make sure customer issues are resolved.

• Keep the owner informed of outstanding orders, customer issues, and anything requiring attention.



Accuracy is extremely important. We want someone who notices when something doesn’t look right and asks questions.



Who We Are Looking For



Our ideal candidate is:



• Extremely organized and detail-oriented.

• Proactive and able to work independently.

• Dependable and consistent.

• An excellent written communicator in English.

• Warm, professional, and confident communicating with U.S. customers.

• Comfortable managing many conversations and follow-up dates simultaneously.

• Naturally good at keeping track of details.

• Comfortable learning new software and systems.

• Responsive during agreed-upon working hours.

• Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear.

• Interested in becoming a long-term member of a growing small business.



Experience with any of the following is especially valuable:



• HubSpot

• CRM management

• Wholesale sales

• B2B sales outreach

• Lead generation

• E-commerce

• Shopify

• Customer service/customer success

• Order management

• U.S. retail or gift industry

•
 outreach



You do not need experience in every area listed above. We care most about intelligence, communication, organization, reliability, and willingness to learn.



You Will Be Successful in This Position If You:



• Never let a follow-up disappear because you forgot about it.

• Keep accurate records without being reminded.

• Notice potential problems before they become bigger problems.

• Enjoy building relationships with customers.

• Can write personalized
s rather than sending generic spam.

• Take initiative when you see something that needs to be done.

• Communicate clearly when you need information from us.

• Care about the success of the business.

• Take pride in doing excellent work.



What This Position Is NOT



This is not a position for someone who needs a detailed list of tasks every morning before beginning work.



We will provide training, expectations, and systems, but we ultimately want someone who can take ownership of their responsibilities.



It is also not a high-volume spam
 position. We would rather send fewer thoughtful, personalized
s to highly relevant retailers than hundreds of generic messages.



Hours & Compensation



This position will begin at approximately 15–20 hours per week.



Starting compensation is $5–$7 USD per hour depending on experience and qualifications.



There is potential for additional hours, responsibilities, and compensation as the business grows and you demonstrate that you can successfully take ownership of the role.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position, not a short-term project.



Some overlap with U.S. business hours will be required for customer communication and collaboration.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Tell us about your previous experience.



In particular, tell us about any experience you have with:



• Wholesale or B2B sales

• Customer service

• Lead generation

• CRM management

• HubSpot

• Shopify/e-commerce

• Order management



2. What hours are you currently available to work?



Please include your time zone and tell us what hours you could regularly overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



3. Tell us about your current work commitments.



Are you currently working for other clients? If so, approximately how many hours per week?



4. Describe a system you have used to make sure customer follow-ups don’t get forgotten.



5. Tell us about your experience with HubSpot.



If you have not used HubSpot, tell us which CRM systems you have used.



Short Application Exercise



Imagine National Park Magic sells a beautiful Great Smoky Mountains National Park ornament, and you have identified a boutique near the Smoky Mountains that appears to be a great potential wholesale customer.



Please write:



A. The initial cold
 you would send to the store introducing National Park Magic and asking if they would be interested in carrying our products.



B. The follow-up
 you would send approximately one week later if they did not respond.



C. A short explanation of what information you would record in HubSpot after sending these
s.



Please write these yourself. We are specifically interested in seeing your natural written English, judgment, and communication style.



At the very end of your application, please write the words “National Park Magic” so we know you carefully read the entire job description.



About Our Team



National Park Magic is a growing small business, which means the right person can have a meaningful impact.



We want someone who will learn our business, understand our customers, help us improve our systems, and grow with us over time.



If you are organized, proactive, dependable, excellent at communication, and excited about helping a growing American gift brand develop relationships with retailers across the country, we would love to hear from you.

title: High-Ticket Account Manager | US Clients - $1,500–$2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

description:

title: Virtual Assistant for Events & Marketing Coordination in Australia
description:
How to apply — mandatory requirements



Two things are required from every applicant. No exceptions.

- A 3-minute Loom video. Introduce yourself, walk through your relevant coordination or events experience. Please speak naturally and DO NOT read from a script.

- Submit an updated CV in a PDF format



Applications missing either the Loom video or the CV will NOT be considered.



Summary:

We're a recruitment partner hiring on behalf of an established Australian company that runs large-scale public food and lifestyle events.



They need one organised, reliable person to keep each event moving — coordinating vendors, running marketing campaigns, and making sure nothing gets forgotten. You won't be d
 strategy or creative. You'll be the person who makes sure what was d
 actually happens.



If you're someone who likes lists, hates loose ends, and quietly enjoys chasing people until they reply, you'll do well here.



What you'll be doing

Six areas, roughly in order of how much time they take:

- Vendor coordination — sending contracts and welcome packs to 20–25 vendors per event, collecting their documents, answering their questions, and following up until everything's in

- Tracking and reporting — owning the event task tracker, chasing what's overdue, and sending a short end-of-day summary so nothing depends on anyone's memory

- Marketing execution —
 and SMS campaigns, social posts,
 Events, and updating event pages on WordPress/Elementor

- Creators and influencers — briefing them, confirming attendance, chasing content, saving links

- Supplier bookings — equipment, power, cleaning, security: booking, confirming, and following up delivery

- Post-event wrap-up — reconciling vendor commissions and pulling the final event report together



What we're looking for

- Experience coordinating projects, operations or events remotely. Events experience is a bonus, not a requirement — organised project coordination from any industry counts

- You follow up relentlessly, politely, and without being asked

- Detail-oriented, with a habit of saving proof rather than just ticking a box

- Comfortable with spreadsheets and task management tools; confident you can pick up WordPress and Elementor

- Clear, professional written English — you'll be the main contact for dozens of vendors

- Good judgement about what to handle yourself and what to escalate



Hours

- Full-time, 40 hours per week on Australian Eastern Standard Time. Events run Friday to Sunday, so some weekend availability is needed during event weeks. We'd rather be upfront about this now than have it surprise you later.
