title: Embedded Systems / Mechatronics Engineer – Smart IoT Product Prototype | ESP32, Sensors, LEDs, Display, Camera
description:
HappyMat™️ is seeking an experienced embedded systems/mechatronics engineer in the Philippines to develop the electronics and firmware architecture for a functional smart consumer-product prototype.



This is a hands-on physical prototyping project—not a software-only assignment.



The prototype incorporates an ESP32-class MCU and/or Linux SBC, Wi-Fi/BLE, pressure/presence sensing, addressable RGB lighting, digital display, camera, speaker/microphone, and smartphone connectivity.



Primary responsibilities: select appropriate development hardware and components; design the prototype electronics architecture; integrate pressure/presence sensors, LEDs, display, camera and audio; develop embedded firmware; establish Wi-Fi/BLE connectivity; build and test the electronics; troubleshoot the assembled system; create wiring/schematic documentation and BOM; and coordinate with our mechanical/CAD engineer.



Production certification and a production PCB are not required for Prototype #1. Commercially available development modules are encouraged when they reduce cost and development time.



Required experience: ESP32/ESP-IDF/Arduino/PlatformIO; embedded C/C++ and/or Python; sensors and load cells/FSRs; addressable LEDs; LCD/OLED displays; Wi-Fi/BLE; low-voltage DC power systems; soldering, assembly and debugging of physical prototypes.



Raspberry Pi/Linux SBC, camera/audio integration, PCB design and IoT product-development experience are strong advantages.



To apply, answer the following:



1. Show 2–3 physical electronic prototypes you personally built.

2. Which portions did you personally engineer?

3. Describe your experience with ESP32 and/or Raspberry Pi.

4. For a product combining sensors, RGB LEDs, display, camera and audio, what general controller architecture would you consider and why?

5. Can you physically assemble and test the prototype in the Philippines?

6. What equipment do you personally have available for electronics prototyping and testing?

7. What city are you located in?

8. What is your availability during the next 4–8 weeks?

9. Are you willing to sign an NDA?



Start your response with “HAPPYMAT EMBEDDED”. Generic or AI-generated proposals that do not answer the questions will not be considered.

We’re looking for a highly detail-oriented Design QA + Operations Specialist to be the final quality check before work reaches our clients. We are a purpose-driven design studio that supports nonprofits who make the world better.



Your job is simple:



Nothing leaves QA with an error that a checklist could have caught.



You’ll review every design round, catch errors, verify client feedback was addressed, and make sure files are technically ready for print or digital delivery.



This is not primarily a design role. You should be comfortable in InDesign, but your superpower is accuracy and attention to detail.



What you'll own



70% — Quality Assurance



* Proof every round before it reaches our clients.

* Check copy against the approved document: names, numbers, titles, captions, credits, etc.

* Verify long lists name-by-name.

* Check print specs: page count, pagination, spreads, bleed, margins, image resolution, color, fonts, packaging, etc.

* Check digital specs: dimensions, links, alt text, file naming, exports, etc.

* Review every feedback comment and confirm it has been addressed.

* Make sure collateral is delivered in the correct sizes from Round 1.

* Send anything that fails QA back to the designer.



30% — Design Operations



* Keep files, versions, assets, and final packaging organized.

* Maintain the designer QA checklist and SOPs.

* Prepare files for Tuesday critique and capture takeaways.

* Track recurring errors and help improve our processes.



How we'll measure success



* Zero preventable QA errors reach the client.

* 100% of rounds have a completed QA sheet.

* 100% of feedback comments are closed or answered.

* Print files pass production specs before handoff.



You’re a good fit if…



* You've proofed or produced real multi-page printed publications.

* You understand spreads, pagination, bleed, trim, and multiples of 4.

* You're fluent enough in InDesign to inspect, fix, package, and export files.

* You're EXTREMELY detail-oriented and call yourself Type-A.

* You communicate clearly and concisely.

* You aren't afraid to send work back when something isn't right.

* You flag problems early instead of saying, “Looks good.”

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location: Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: August



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:30 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: Senior Local SEO & AI Search Manager
description:
We are not looking for someone who needs an SEO task list.



We are looking for the person who creates the task list.



Leap Windows & Doors is a family-owned replacement window and door company serving homeowners In North Carolina. Our owner has almost 30 years in the industry. We hold a 4.9 star Google rating and we are A+ rated and accredited by the Better Business Bureau. We operate from two offices and plan 1 to 2 new locations in the next 6 months.



We are bringing SEO in-house and want one experienced Local SEO professional to take ownership of our organic search growth.



You will own:

Local SEO

Both Google Business Profiles + new locations

Google Maps visibility

Website SEO

Technical SEO

On-page optimization

Location and service-page growth

Content map, content calendar, and AI-assisted drafts written to our brand knowledge base and approved before publishing

Internal linking

Citation management

Parasite SEO strategy and execution

Link strategy and local authority building

Digital PR opportunities

Competitor research

GA4, Search Console, call tracking, and CRM attribution reporting

AI-search, AEO, and GEO visibility, where we already get real leads from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity

SEO launch planning for new physical locations



You will make normal website changes yourself. Our site runs on a proprietary CMS, not WordPress, and we do not have an in-house developer, so template-level competence matters. This CMS uses a simple to use editor for quick changes and the CMS support staff is available for larger page builds and technical updates. Long term, we will be moving off of this CMS and you will be involved in that migration. 



We already have:

A real operating company with a physical HQ in Burlington, NC and a second office in Greensboro

Over 2,000 North Carolina homeowners served

Strong reviews

An established website with existing search visibility

Existing paid, direct mail, radio, and local events marketing

A written brand knowledge base for you to inherit

A budget for approved tools and outside resources



This role is about growing qualified leads measured in our CRM, not creating reports that only show activity.



We want someone who:

Has 4 to 7+ years of real, hands-on SEO experience

Has personally produced measurable Local SEO results for US service businesses

Understands Google Business Profile beyond posting updates

Can explain why one company outranks another

Understands technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO

Can work confidently inside a proprietary CMS (WordPress experience is a fine proxy)

Can build and improve normal website pages

Writes and validates schema by hand

Uses Search Console and GA4 at an advanced level

Understands local rank-grid tracking

Has built citations and quality links without chasing junk volume

Understands how SEO, Local SEO, and AI search fit together as one system

Uses AI heavily where it improves the work, and checks important output instead of accepting it blindly

Writes natural US English a homeowner would read without noticing it was written offshore

Notices problems without being told to look, and tells us early when something is wrong

Follows a brand rulebook exactly, and pushes back with data when a rule seems wrong

Can turn data into a clear action plan

Works independently and takes deadlines seriously

Keeps learning as search changes



Home-services SEO experience is a major plus. Multi-location, digital PR, advanced off-site SEO, third-party publishing, social-search strategy, or CRM attribution experience is also a plus.



AI use matters:



We do not care whether you prefer ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or another strong AI system. We do care how you use it.

We are looking for someone who uses AI to improve work such as:



Keyword clustering and intent classification

Search Console analysis

Competitor research and content-gap analysis

Content briefs and first drafts against a written knowledge base

Internal-link analysis

Schema drafting and checking

Technical research

Large spreadsheet and data analysis

Reporting

Simple scripts and automations

Repeatable workflows



Using AI only to write blog posts is not enough for this role. You should know what data the model is using, what must be checked, what cannot be trusted without outside proof, and when AI is creating noise instead of useful work.



How we work:



You will have a weekly meeting with the marketing director and maintain a simple SEO scorecard.



Each week we expect you to tell us what changed, what you completed, what you learned, what needs attention, and what you are doing next.



We judge results measured in our CRM, not activity reports and not platform-reported numbers. We would rather hear a flat month explained accurately than a good-looking report we cannot trust.



We have strict, written rules about how certain facts about our company are worded. You will get the knowledge base. You will follow it exactly. You will never invent a statistic or a claim to fill a page.



You will have a budget for approved SEO tools, citations, memberships, PR, and link opportunities.



You are being hired for your judgment, not just your labor.



Schedule:



We need 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern business hours every working day, agreed in writing and sustained. We do not need you awake all night. If a full US day shift is not realistic for you long term, tell us what is. We would rather agree on a schedule you can keep for years than one that collapses in month three.



Equipment and connection:



Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection or backup power, and a computer that can run crawls and screen-share without lag. You will be asked to show a speed test.



Compensation:



$1,400 to $1,700 USD per month depending on experience and verified results. Strong candidates may be considered above the listed range.



Also included:



13th month pay

Paid time off

Company-paid SEO tools and memberships

A 6-month performance review with a defined raise path

Long-term, full-time position with one employer



Shortlisted candidates complete a paid practical test before the final interview. Every finalist who completes it in good faith is paid.



How to Apply:



Do not send only a generic resume. Generic applications are deleted.



Use this subject line exactly: SEO - [Your Name] - Frog



Answer these seven questions. Short, specific answers beat long general ones. Links, screenshots, and proof are welcome.



1. Local SEO proof



Give us your two strongest Local SEO results. For each, include: business type, market, website URL if you are allowed to share it, what you personally did, starting situation, measurable result, and how you verified the result.



2. Google Business Profile proof



Give us one example where you materially improved Google Maps or GBP visibility. Tell us the problem, what you changed, what happened, and how you measured it.



3. AI use



Tell us how you currently use AI in your SEO work. Give us three specific workflows you actually use today. For each: which AI tool you use, what you give it, what it produces, and what you still check or do manually.



4. AI judgment



Give us one example of a time AI gave you an SEO recommendation, analysis, or output that was wrong or weak. How did you catch it? What did you do instead?



5. Independent thinking



Imagine you start Monday and nobody gives you an SEO task list. You have access to our website, both Google Business Profiles, Search Console, GA4, rank tracking, and SEO tools. What would you want to understand first before d
 what to work on?



6. Brand rules



While writing a page under a strict brand rulebook, you find a claim you cannot verify. What do you do? Two or three sentences.



7. Logistics



Desired monthly compensation, normal working hours, US Eastern Time availability, and whether you currently work for any other clients or employers.



We care much more about clear thinking and proven results than certifications. Applicants who follow these instructions exactly are reviewed first.

title: Grok Bot Development Lead (Part-Time, 20 hours per week)
description:
About the opportunity



We are a growing US-based business training and media company, and we are looking for a skilled Grok Bot Development Lead. This role owns the AI bot system that finds, scores, and opens conversations with community and event owners so our team can interview them. The bots find and open. People still make the calls, run the interviews, and teach. You build and run the machine that feeds them.



What you will do



Build and maintain two Grok Bots in a dedicated internal workspace: a Researcher that finds, scores, and tracks prospects, and an Opener that drafts and, after human approval, sends
 and LinkedIn messages. Neither bot ever phones or joins a video call.

Write and maintain the standing orders for each bot, including explicit guard rules covering what each bot must never do, and fail any draft that breaks them.

Enrich and score one assigned prospect group from a targeting blueprint, capturing name, title, organization,
, LinkedIn, phone where available, latest public topic, a verbatim public quote, warm relationship flag, decision maker plus up to two lieutenants, and the events contact. Score zero to five against a published rubric and release only the top tier, roughly twenty organizations for the live test rather than two hundred.

Keep every contact's pipeline stage current in GoHighLevel, from first request through called, booked, interviewed, and closed states. GoHighLevel is the only source of truth. No side spreadsheet.

Wire the GoHighLevel intake form and the group-labeled calendar link so the booking, the prep fields, and the status card all agree, then test the whole flow yourself as a prospect would experience it.

Hold send discipline: daily caps per channel, staggered
 and LinkedIn to the same person, one follow-up and then stop, and an immediate channel freeze plus supervisor alert if bounces or platform warnings spike.

Queue drafts for supervisor approval before sending, log subject, body variant, channel, and result, and bring a weekly short list of which copy to keep and which to retire.

Produce the one-page pre-interview brief the same day a slot books, and send a nightly written note to the supervisor covering asks, replies, bookings, no-shows, and next actions.



Schedule and setup



Hours: 20 hours per week

Working hours: the business operates 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Pacific time. You choose which 20 hours you work inside that window, and you keep the same schedule week to week so the supervisor knows when to expect you. For applicants in the Philippines this is a night shift, roughly 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM Manila time

Setup: reliable internet and a dedicated computer for the bot workspace. The approved sending Gmail and an approved test LinkedIn profile are provided. Personal accounts are never used for outreach



Must-have skills and tools



Hands-on experience building and operating AI agents or bots: standing orders, group chats, send queues, connected
 accounts, guard rules

GoHighLevel: pipelines, stages, forms, calendars, contact records

List enrichment and prospect scoring against a written rubric

Writing instructions precise enough for a bot to obey, with a clear line between what it does and what it must not do

 and LinkedIn deliverability fundamentals: sending caps, staggering, follow-up limits, and when to freeze a channel

Ability to follow a tight build brief without redesigning the project

Escalates in writing with a proposed option the same day, not with a verbal debug dump

Strong written English



Nice to have



Direct experience inside Grok Bot workspaces

Gmail deliverability and domain warm-up experience

Experience supporting interview, podcast, or speaker booking outreach



Compensation



USD 500 per month for 20 hours per week.



How to apply

Apply here and Include the words "standing order" in the first line of your application so we know you read the full posting.

title: Purchase Order Administrator
description:
Job Title: Purchase Order Administrator (Remote – Philippines Based, Day Shift)



About Us

Life Interiors is a leading Australian modern furniture retailer with showrooms in Sydney, Melbourne, and Brisbane, supported by a thriving e-commerce store. With 17 years in the industry, we are passionate about great design, detail, and seamless operations.



We are expanding our global team and looking for a highly organised Purchase Order Administrator based in the Philippines. This role ensures smooth order processing, supplier communications, and accurate purchase order management within our ERP system (NetSuite).



What’s In It for You?

*100% work-from-home (remote flexibility).

*Day shift schedule – aligned with Australian business hours.

*Competitive salary package based on experience.

*13th month performance-based bonus

*HMO/health coverage after probation.

*Annual leave + sick leave.

*Long-term career stability with a growing, design-led company.

*Supportive and collaborative international team environment.



Job Overview

You will play a key role in the administration, coordination, and communication of purchase orders. You’ll ensure all details are accurate, timelines are met, and records are properly maintained across our ERP system (NetSuite).

You’ll be the link between our suppliers, internal teams, and freight partners — keeping everything organised and on track.



Key Responsibilities

*Accurately raise, upload, and manage purchase orders in NetSuite.

*Confirm product details, quantities, costs, and ETDs with suppliers.

*Track order progress and proactively follow up to avoid delays.

*Liaise with the Product and Management teams regarding any discrepancies in fabrication, cost, or delivery.

*Communicate with Freight Forwarders to ensure bookings and documentation are submitted on time.

*Work with the Supply Chain and Warehouse teams to resolve inventory discrepancies.

*Check and confirm carton layouts prior to shipping.

*Provide regular updates on inbound container schedules.

*Support the creation of new product entries in the system.

*Continuously seek ways to improve processes and workflows.



About You

*2+ years’ experience in administration, purchasing support, or stock/order management.

*Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.

*Clear and professional communicator (written and verbal).

*Experienced with ERP/CRM systems (NetSuite preferred but not essential).

*Proficient in Excel and confident working with data.

*Self-motivated, proactive, and reliable — able to manage tasks independently.

*Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.

*Experience in furniture, retail, or logistics is a plus, but not required.



A competitive salary package will be offered, commensurate with experience and demonstrated capability.





*Join us and be part of a global team where your organisational skills will directly contribute to the success of a modern, growing furniture brand.

title: Inbound Sales & Client Care Specialist
description:
Inbound Sales & Client Care Specialist – Home Services



NW Cleaning Crew is a small and growing residential cleaning company based in Washington State, USA.



We’re looking for an experienced phone-first Client Care & Inbound Sales Specialist who can be one of the first voices our potential clients hear.



This is not primarily an admin role.



Your main responsibility will be responding to incoming leads, having warm and natural conversations, helping clients understand the right service for their needs, following up, and confidently asking for the booking.



We’ll teach you NW Cleaning Crew, our services, systems, scripts, and standards.



You should already know how to:

• Speak clearly and confidently with U.S.-based clients

• Build rapport naturally over the phone

• Listen and ask good questions

• Handle objections professionally

• Follow a sales process without sounding robotic

• Ask for the booking

• Follow up consistently

• Think on your feet while knowing when to verify instead of guessing



This is not an entry-level phone role. We are looking for someone who already has experience in customer service, inbound sales, appointment setting, phone sales, or closing.



Because we are still growing, this is not a nonstop call-center environment. There will be quieter periods. During that time, you’ll help with light client care and admin, follow-up, call review, learning our services, and continued sales practice.



This role works during U.S. Pacific Time business hours, so you must be comfortable working a schedule aligned with Washington State.



WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT OUR COMPANY



We’re small enough that your work really matters.



We value kindness, ownership, communication, growth, and people who want to get better.



You won’t just be answering phones. You’ll be helping shape how clients experience NW Cleaning Crew and helping us grow.



TO APPLY



Please send a short 2–3 minute face-to-camera video answering all three questions below.



Applications without a video will not be considered.



Please start your video by saying the word "RESET."  Then:



1. Tell me briefly about your experience with inbound calls, customer service, sales, appointment setting, or closing.



2. What is something you’ve done professionally that you’re genuinely proud of, and why?



3. Mini phone scenario:



Pretend I’m a new client calling NW Cleaning Crew and I say:



“Hi, I’m looking to get my house cleaned and I’m just trying to get an idea of pricing.”



Respond exactly how you would if you were answering that call.



Please speak naturally and do not read from notes.



I’m listening for clear spoken English, warmth, confidence, natural conversation, listening skills, and how comfortably you guide a potential client through a phone call.



If this sounds like a role you’d be excited to grow into, I’d love to hear from you.
